<nobr>Custom-made</nobr> for the Druvis family by Lugus, this 1900 commemorative edition is a part of the premium series of Samildánach Jewelry. It is also the only luxury accessory Druvis III wears. It first came out in October 1911, at a birthday party held by a mother for her daughter.
Wand "Otherworld"

This is an incredibly peculiar wand. It appears to be an oak druid staff, with a white <nobr>scythe-shaped</nobr> decoration which signifies the holy moon on top and the white buds of mistletoe surrounding it. Its core is made of cat whiskers, expired painkillers and a handful of black ashes. She has named it "Otherworld."
A Bouquet of Mistletoe

The layering of the flower arrangement, the silk decoration, and the green and white flowers go so well with her clothing that the final result is almost a work of art. "It wasn't <nobr>custom-made</nobr>. I just picked them up at random" She said. I should probably find myself a new bouquet designer.
The Roaring Twenties

The 1920s witnessed a boom in cubism. The preference of geometric features not only influenced the design of the Chrysler Building but also changed the design of women's clothes. As new ideas collided with the old, a revolutionary change took place—the modernization of society. In the US, modern science was realizing dreams. Steam trains, Ford cars and the radio gave the world every reason to feel optimistic about the future. Jazz music was played throughout the night, and the people dancing the Charleston never felt tired. Nobody could stay out of the craze, especially those aristocrats who had fallen from a position of power but still tried to find a respectable place in America. "Stop telling me about your illusions." The mother gently threw a genogram with an oak sigil on it into the fireplace. "The moment you got on that ship, you became an American." 
"Embrace the 'New Age' with us."
Autumn in Cascade

She remembers every tree growing in the Cascade Range.
The shape of the moss on the trunk, the uneven pattern of the tree rings, the size of the ant colony by its root... They make every tree different in its own way. To listen to their whispers, she failed her mother again and again, running away from the endless banquets into the long night of the forest.
Her stepfather was also familiar with every tree in the Cascade Range.
As a tycoon in the logging industry, he was keen to give a lengthy speech about the value of woods.
The faster his stock price rose, the more talkative he became.
Things changed, however, in 1928.
The supply chain of woods suddenly collapsed, and he became more and more silent. The Great Depression left out no one—it is like another <nobr>upper-class</nobr> banquet, but this time no one wished to be invited. At that point, bulldozing the forest and selling the land seemed to be the only choice. When her parents signed the contract, she was nestling against the branches of an oak, trying to keep a feather floating in the air with her incantation.
In this autumn in Cascade, she wished to live differently.
A Different Philosophy

Pandora Wilson: I heard that your mother betrayed her arcanist family for the American Dream. I'm curious, what is your understanding of the American Dream?
Druvis III: I don't understand it.
Pandora Wilson: ...

Pandora Wilson: What if you were to describe it in one word? I think the American Dream is a belief, if you ask me.
Druvis III: It's also business.
Pandora Wilson: It's like a firework show.
Druvis III: It's like a mess of ashes.
Pandora Wilson: You seem to have a quite negative approach to it. 
Druvis III: I'm sure everyone sees it differently.
Druvis III: Perhaps, we can only truly understand what the American Dream is after hearing enough criticism about it.

Prank War

After WWII, the eagle and the bear bared their fangs at the throne.
The Iron Curtain speech signaled the beginning of the lengthy Cold War. The government picked out the children with arcanum talent from all over the world and sent them to Zeno Armaments Engineering and Technology Academy where they would be trained to become a hidden yet powerful force. 
Under the strict adminstration of Zeno, they have grown into obedient, persistent, efficient and silent soldiers.

But they were still young children after all, and children always make trouble.
They came from different countries and had different faiths, ideas and habits, which led to conflicts. The most noticeable troublemaker among them was, without a doubt, the pilot girl from Russia.
That was the 13th time she defeated her challengers. The exhaust of her broom raised a cloud of dust as her opponent cried.

"Told you ... it won't work. We shouldn't have messed with her. Why won't you listen to me?!"
"He's right. Don't overestimate yourselves." She made a face towards the child who fell to the ground, "The director wants to see me. Take your time, losers! <nobr>Boo-hoo</nobr>, mommy ..."
Barents Sea Witch

"Air squadron 333 to HQ, we have entered the Barents Sea zone. Initiating mission Echo Exploration."
"Take care. You know where you are. Don't be spotted by the bear."

"It's 1039 and we're spotted. An unidentified aircraft is nearby. It's smaller and faster than a fighter ... I can't see it."
"Just calm down and shake it off. Those patrol drones can't harm you. Attacking them won't do you any ..."
"Gosh, that's nuts! It has reached us! That's not a fighter, it's a witch! You won't believe this, it's a witch, uh no, a pilot on a metal aircraft ... Gosh! Those rumors about the arcanists are true! How can she fly so fast?! Is she outta her mind?! We're all gonna die!"
"Calm down! Calm, down!"
"How the hell am I supposed to calm down?! She's coming for us! She got me▃▃▂▂ZZZT!!▃▃▂▂Damn it, I swear she has cut the engine or something else open. We are going down! We are going down!"

The Curtain Rises

The 1590s was the age of liberated minds. Inspired by the Renaissance and encouraged by the rise of humanism, people living under the reign of Elizabeth I no longer worried about filling their bellies, but grew thirsty for better art.
It was also the prime of European theatre. Shakespeare was the people's favourite, but the others were no less popular. At that time, Shakespeare was famous for his romantic comedies, such as A Midsummer Night's Dream and The Merchant of Venice. People watched them, talked about them, wrote and sang about them ...
More and more people jumped on the bandwagon.
A Weaver? An Actor?

He is an outstanding weaver.
Building frames, weaving fabrics, repairing woodwork... He receives requests from the villagers constantly and he knows every saw, needle and thread he uses like the back of his hand. The tools move nimbly in his hands like fluttering butterflies.
He plans to stick to this job till the last day of his life.

He is also an excellent actor.
Finding the right roles, memorizing lines, adjusting his performance at rehearsals ... As lengthy and arduous as it sounds, an opportunity to be part of a play does not come often. It was his first time playing a donkey, surrounded by Peaseblossom, Cobweb and Mustardseed. He danced with the fairy queen to her song. 
He also plans on acting till the last day of his life.
His Play Is On Forever

"You are a mini version of him." 
She turned around to see who was behind her. It was a young boy, wearing some research center uniform, and there was a strange butterfly embroidered on his clothes.

White Stone House

There was a white house in the city made of white stones. Everyone knew that it was Dr. Nicholas's house.
The high wall divided Germany into two halves. They lost each other, yet exchanged gazes unceasingly.
For the world, it was an earthshaking reformation. For the poor who were just born or ill in bed, however, it meant there weren't even pills to treat them. That was when Mr. and Mrs. Nicholas appeared.
The two of them were great doctors but terrible parents. When they returned from work in the neighboring city, they found their <nobr>7-year</nobr>-old daughter had a persistent high fever from a serious infection.

However, she was a miraculously fortunate child.
When her breathing stopped, her mother noticed that her chest was abnormally swollen. Together, the two of them lifted the body of their daughter, which was still warm. They slapped her in the back hard and, soon enough, she coughed out a balloon. Then came the second, the third ... the room was filled with balloons of varying styles and patterns.
After this bizarre vomiting, she recovered completely.
The white stone house was <nobr>re-decorated</nobr>, like a party that was never held.

A strange woman had come to the town. She was wearing a strange costume and talking about strange things, but all the children had gathered by her side.
Something must be wrong.
Because, I mean, even Emily went to see her.
"Dad, please ..." Emily tried so hard to beg me that she was trembling again as usual, "Tommy also got this balloon ..."
"But my sweetheart Tommy is a lucky boy. He won't be punished for a ridiculous balloon."
She knew what was going to happen. She huddled, trembling, which was my favorite scene. "See, your mother always cried the same way before she left me ... I hate to see that ..."

I broke her balloon, but before her scream rang out, I was drowned by great pain and fell to the ground.
The next day, I was in hospital.
My internal organs were damaged, and the doctor said they would never recover. I had to be very careful with my lifestyle and say goodbye to alcohol and excess grease. From the nurses' chitchat, I learned that Tommy's broken leg was cured overnight; the plaster on his leg appeared in the garbage station outside the town, mixed with balloon pieces.

I think I know what that thing wandering outside the window last night was. I will be a good father, at least from now on.

The First Night

The wolves were invading.
They crossed fences and walls and sneaked into people's homes.
The poor village had a small population but was brightly illuminated that night. People awakened amid shrieks, children wailed and wolves howled under the full moon. Blood seeped into the creek and created a winding path of tragedy.

The females became huntresses on that night.
The hunters who had gone to the forest were dead. Before the mourning and prayer for them ended, the huntresses put on their cloaks and charged into the night. <nobr>Twenty-one</nobr> rounds were shot from the hunting rifles and the big bad wolves retreated into the forest. The cloaks were soaked red with the blood of the wolves, after the bloody counterattack for what they had done.
The one thing that held the village together was the defense made by grandmothers, mothers, sisters and daughters. Every night, women could be seen carrying guns and watching over this fragile cradle, until day broke and the wolves returned to the forest.
Fierce Fighting

The huntresses' and the wolves' bodies rotted away in the forest, turning into a single pile of dust, just like the mixing of their blood which was inseparable since the first night. A Promising Young Doctor

Rabies was raging in the city.
It was an incurable disease with a fatality rate of almost 100%. The patients could do nothing but wait in desperation to lose their senses or their lives.
For the doctors, it was an unbeatable nightmare: no matter how hard they tried, they couldn't save any of their patients.
For the patients, the disease was absolutely egalitarian: anyone infected would meet the same doom, regardless of their status or identity.

Bitten by her own dog, she suffered from madness and was on the verge of death. However, the next morning, everyone read the breaking news of her cure instead of the obituary they had expected. The news mentioned a doctor who was a close friend of the patient and that he cured the disease all by himself.
It was the beginning of a promising future, where humans would finally overcome rabies. People called him the Young Doctor with Great Potential and wondered who he really was.

On the <nobr>light-gray</nobr> floor and the walls scatter the logos in <nobr>champagne-like</nobr> color. The <nobr>well-arranged</nobr> stone pillars manifest the greatness of this building while the cold, hard cement bricks and granite bring about order and obedience to this place.
It must be a magnificent scene when it collapses.
But will that really happen?
I'm not sure. I can't even tell if it is really built with cement bricks and granite.
It's just ...
It's just somehow, I have a strange feeling since I arrived.
It feels ... strangely familiar.
That familiarity feels so natural and justifiable, like the smell of wheat when you cut the white bread, or the yellowed postcard found in the middle of a book.
At this moment, a flash of inspiration strikes me, like a lightning flickering in the depths of my brain.
I don't remember anything.#Hold on to that momentary feeling
But the familiarity is not just an illusion. I know that.
A spark lights up the match. "Fwoosh," a small, flickering flame appears in silence.
I am running out of time. I must leave and do what I should do.
Instructor
Vertin?
What are you doing here? The training has started. C'mon, do what you're supposed to do.
What I'm supposed to do?
It's settled. My complete victory.
As their standard wands fall to the dust, the delightful ringing from outside the fence declares my victory.
Winner, Vertin.
Congratulations. Your excellent performance has brought you an undoubted victory.
You are the best graduate of the year, and I'll be more than willing to prepare an honorary certificate and a reference which is commensurate with your performance.
But before that, you must complete a small final test for your graduation.
Some rioters of the Manus has captured this building. Go show them what you've got.
So that's ... what I'm supposed to do?
For the <nobr>well-being</nobr> of mankind.
French?
Vous !
What are you looking at? Don't play dumb, it's you!
Yeah that's right, you!
Busted, huh?! You've been peeking at her! I saw you!
She talks so fast, reminding people of the tranquil lake which reflects the snow on the Alps.
But of course, she has nothing like the lake itself. She is like the speedboat making huge noises on the lake which ruin the tranquility and shredder the serenity of the snow mountain into pieces.
Who?
<nobr>H-H</nobr>-H ... Her, of course.
Her tone suddenly goes down as if this speedboat had run out of power.
She keeps hinting a direction with frequent glances, as if there lies a strong magnet which causes the failure of the speedboat's engine or attracts her eyes forcibly.
Who is she?#Actually I was staring at you.
What? <nobr>Y-Y</nobr>-You ... You don't know who she is?
What?!
<nobr>Y-You</nobr> saw me ...? No, I didn't peek at her all the time! Hey, you hear me?
You'd better keep this in mind, she's MY rival! Only I get to beat her!
Correction: only a rival like her deserves to be beaten by the incredible me! Remember, the No.1 student can be no one but me!
I'll make you understand that!
<nobr>N-No</nobr> way, the incredible me lost to you ... This can't be true!
She runs away while talking to herself.
So what on earth was she doing?
In the shadow of the ship hide several rioters of Manus Vindictae.
Speaking of which, what does Manus Vindictae mean? Is it some kind of arcane skill?
Their bodies look just the same as anyone else's, but the creepy way they move around somehow seems to be slimy and logy.
Black slime dropping from the gaps of their armors and robes, they look disgustingly creepy.
I have to admit I am curious about the nature of the slime, but I will never, ever touch it.
Curiosity doesn't always result in action. That's the difference between human and moth.
Those satisfying their curiosity without consideration will eventually pay for their thoughtlessness.
I've been there.
And that was quite high a price.
The rioters of the Manus have spotted me and their scream pierces my ears. It seems I can't describe them as friendly.
My eardrums slightly ache, as if there's a ball bouncing on them.
At last, everything is settled and nothing is left.
I am clear what I should do. I have made up my mind, and all I need is a little push.
I will beat them to prove myself.
A strange question suddenly comes to my mind: what am I fighting for?
This question must mean something, but I don't have to figure it out right now. All I need to do is to beat them, as ordered by the instructor.
Mission completed. Time to go back and report.
I will be the best graduate of SPDM of the year.
An <nobr>orange-haired</nobr> girl is looking up at the ceiling. She seems to be thinking about something.
It seems she's meant to be there, like a fact to be taken for granted, like the Boston ivy is meant to be found on the outer wall of this building.
But she seems so out of place at the same time, just like the orange China rose blooming out of the Boston ivy, which is generally impossible.
She belongs here, though she shouldn't have.
I know her.
My memory starts to bright up from the moment I see her.
<nobr>Orange-haired</nobr> Girl
Vertin? What are you doing here?
I'm ... carrying out a mission given by the instructor.
The instructor has always liked you. Back at school, I was always the one standing in the corner while you were always praised by the instructor.
Her words somehow sound strange to me. Is that real?
Maybe it is so. Then should I act prouder of myself?
But I will leave here and go work for the Foundation in the future. By then, we won't be seeing each other as often as we are now.
So I'm thinking ...
Yeah?
Hmm ...
*squeak* ...
I hear the shrill squeak of Glires, rattling like two pieces of rusted iron rubbing each other. Something nasty falls along with the rust.
Well ... I'm more than happy to share the result of my brooding, but before that ... we need to deal with a small problem. Please give me a hand.
I thought about a lot of things, like, what the outside world is like, or what my future and your future will be like.
Do you have an answer for that?
Maybe yes, maybe no.
I'm not sure how to explain it to you. We need more time to discuss this issue.
Nevertheless, thank you for helping me. The hour is getting late, please don't forget your "mission".
Thank you for the reminder.
We will meet again, Vertin.
The <nobr>Orange-haired</nobr> Girl has left the building. She has her own business to attend to.
Even though I'm also curious about the outside world, I should focus on the "mission" before me first.
Maybe one day in the future, I will be able to go to the outside world ... with her.
You're back, Vertin.
... Yeah.#Who is Vertin?
You know what I'm going to ask, Ms.
Hmm, I don't know. Maybe it's a name, but that doesn't matter anymore.
How is the mission going?
I think I just asked a meaningless question ... The Foundation has witnessed your performance, after all. You did a very good job.
As I promised, I have prepared an honorary certificate and a reference for you, but there's a small accident: a bunch of Carbuncles took them away.
This will be your last mission in SPDM: find those Carbuncles, destroy them and take back your honors.
Apparently the instructor is lying. The Dust is the only thing Carbuncles take interest in, so there's no way they would spend so much effort taking something meaningless for them.
The instructor seems to know that I have seen through her lame excuse, but that won't make a difference. No matter what the Foundation's order is, all I need to do is to execute it.
The noisy Carbuncles gather in a group, leaving my <nobr>hard-earned</nobr> Honorary certificate and reference on the ground as if they were some kind of garbage.
The Carbuncles don't care what these paper are. They don't need an honorary certificate or a reference, nor can they understand orders.
I don't understand why I have to flex so much muscle for just two pieces of paper, but this is what I should do.
Unsurprisingly, I take back what belongs to me without effort.
I am always the winner, as I always should be. There is no need to doubt that.
In the future, I will continue to loyally carry out every order from the Foundation.
Finally, the deepest and heaviest gate in the Foundation opens to me.
I will walk through it and become someone who deserves the status there.
That's the reward which I was supposed to receive.
The faint ring coming from the dark depths of the passage sounds delightful.
I quicken my pace subconsciously as I hear the ring.
My view is suddenly broadened when I reach the end of the passage.
There is a steamship here, ordinary, unremarkable. Don't stay here for too long, as I still have a lot to do.
You are the best graduate of the year, and I'll be more than willing to prepare an honorary certificate and a reference which is commensurate with your performance.
Yes, for the welfare of mankind.
No, something is wrong.
Everything here must mean more than what we were told. Our fate is not a decided one.
Suddenly, a <nobr>rust-stained</nobr> steamship in the distance draws my attention.
A steamship?
What ... is a steamship doing here?
I must check it out.

I suddenly feel dizzy.
At this moment, I suddenly come to realize why the reality show has not yet started ...
It's because we are already part of the show.
Anyway, I lost my balloon. The moment my points hit zero, the energy of my life has also run out.
My bones are growing out, while the muscles turning in.
I am reshaped into a machine with hard shell, standing inside this huge devourer, waiting for the next customer to come up with their ignorance.
A machine ...?
Yes, I was here because of one.
As I recall this, my eyes flutter open --
I cough fiercely, throwing up balloons from my stomach, like getting something poisonous out of my system.
The park is bustling with people. They are chasing after one dose of joy after another, like patients desperate for medicines.
Among the chaos, she stands alone, like a calm cloud on top of the snowy mountain.
Attracted by her abnormality, I walk towards her.
The Distinguished Lady
They say amusement parks are built for children ...
But I think adults are the ones who need someone to tell them what innocence really is.
What do you think? Are amusement parks built for children or adults?
Children#Adults
Yeah? Seems like an old lady like me can't keep up with the children when it comes to joy nowadays.
She puts away the glass and strokes her hair. The liquid in the glass is as dark as blood in the vein, but she doesn't see it that way.
That's my answer too.
I wish we can talk for a bit more ... But we still have our things to do.
Thanks for telling me this, child.
Here's a VIP card for you, as a token of gratitude. I promise it will never run out of balance.
Don't miss out on tonight's finale ... We will see each other again.
She winks at me slyly and disappears in the crowd.
I receive a <nobr>silver-plated</nobr> card, with a jellyfish floating in the sea printed on it.
Maybe I can hang around before the finale starts.
They are floating in the air, so light and unconstrained, as if they would never leak or break, which is different from the joy of the park.
I spend a brief moment thinking about this park.
Why is it here? What's the purpose of its existence? Who funds it? Who operates it? Will it be here forever? Will it break down? Who promised all this?
Never seen someone pondering on philosophical questions in an amusement park before.
I hear a soft chuckle, softly tickling my ears like a feather.
A distinguished lady in blue dress stands next to me, smiling at me in a serene and undisturbed manner.
Looks like the facilities are not for your age, either, are they?
My good child, come, I believe we will get along well.
I will wait for you at the <nobr>north-west</nobr> area of the park.
She walks away gracefully, leaving a touch of her perfume on my shoulder.
If I'm bound to waste a whole evening here, why not waste a few more moments on other matters?
Welcome, welcome, welcome! Welcome to Bunny Bunny's tong bar!
The bunny ears on the drink machine shake and dance vigorously.
I think I've heard that before.
Order confirmed, thank you for ordering with Bunny Bunny! Good luck!
No, it's not the speed that matters ...
But whether I can get the Bunny Medal ...
Great, I found it.
Nice start! Bravo, lady! I wish I could be as lucky as you!
Here's the receipt.
I receive 5 million points.
I think I start to know how things work here.
Aha, what am I looking at? An idiot who thinks she can keep winning because she just won a game.
The wolf pack on the cards are asleep.
The spade A, alpha of the pack, is lying on the table lazily, paying no attention to the VIP card in my hand.
Wanna try something different, huh?
Come closer then. Show me what you've got.
Not bad, you've learned something.
But you gotta know, you can never win this game by just pulling the handle like a fool.
As the werewolf knocks on the ground, the pack open their eyes, seemingly waiting for something.
I have to flip over all the cards within the time limit.
The strategy hasn't changed. I just need to pay more attention to the time ...
Damn, they are attacking at the same time! That never happened!
Bang!
The werewolf blows away the imaginary smoke from his fingertip and shows an evil grin.
Say goodbye to your baby points, honey.
Cheer up, you're not the worst wretch here. At least your pocket is not yet empty.
A lesson from me for just 4 million points. What a bargain.
I only have 3 million points now.
I can't let it go on like this. I must do something.
A good place for take a break.
It has aromatic coffee, delicious food, cozy environment, and games that won't kill me.
Good evening. Would you like tea or coffee?
Got it. Bunny omelette with rice, and a coffee. You can play a game while waiting.
The hat has flown into the air. Now I need to win the dodge game before the food is served.
No, the key is not to decide the direction, but to find out the landing point and to adapt to the toy body.
I won't lose again.
Terrific, Ms. Timekeeper! I knew you could nail it ...
Here's a refreshment on the house for our regular customer. Wish you a good day!
Her hospitality is as heartwarming as ever. I receive 4 million points.
Since I'm all refreshed, I should try my luck again somewhere else.
A huge wheel is standing in the middle of the park, putting on a <nobr>one-act</nobr> play that draws everyone's attention.
Oh, mine lord! "The time of life is short; to spend that shortness basely were too long."
Since thou hast enough points to waste, why not visit ... the shabby theatre of this humble fool?
The wheel starts to spin, seemingly telling its desire for drops.
He's right ... I can take on a challenge or two, since my points are enough.
I thank thee, mine lord! I reserved the best seat for thee!
The pole on the wide line, excellent. It will be easier for me to dodge other balls.
Speed up#Speed up to the max
There is only one way to win the game: faster and faster.
Somehow, however, a ball painted in the colors of the fool suddenly turns up beside me.
... What are you doing down here?
An actor must act on the stage to be an actor, mine lord!
Beautiful chants coming from above the wheel, the fool's ball dances so fast and wild on the track that I can only see its shadow.
The show has not ended in a satisfying way: the fool left me in the dust and I lost the game.
Oh, grieve not, mine lord! "All that glitters is not gold." What thou hast lost might not be that valuable.
"One fire burns out another's burning, One pain is lessen'd by another's anguish."
I believe the next play shall soothe the pain in thee.
A miserable defeat, and I lost 6 million points - fortunately it's not my card.
The next second, I hear fireworks crackling.
Stage made of gold raises before the Ferris wheel, people crowd around the popular Reality Show star.
The finale has started.
The Superstar
Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for being patient for this most excitable performance ...
First, I will pick out tonight's "lucky audience" ... who is the lucky dog?
The cheering and horns are deafening to my ears. I'm so far away from the stage that I can merely see the movement of her lips.
Suddenly, everyone is quiet. The spotlight suddenly shines on me.
Yes, you! Over there, the lady with a hat, congratulations! Please come to backstage.
In the next moment, the crowd cheers again, which rumbles like thunder in my ears.
They surround me, praise my luck, and push me to behind the curtains.
It seems the Goddess of Fortune is still on my side, but I wonder what the prize is.
The reality show actress gives me an attractive smile, as if she has known me for years.
Boss, congratulations. I smell the Mexican hot sauce on you, then I knew you would be the luckiest of all tonight.
... You will have the exclusive right to sponsor tonight's reality show!
The right to sponsor?#Is that it?
For only 1 million points, you will have all the profit we make tonight in return! A very intriguing offer.
Believe me -- I'm your lucky girl. Give me 1 million dollar, and I will return you 20 million, if not more.
Hey, good fortune won't just fall right into your arms. Even God can't work miracle for you if you keep all the money in the pocket.
For only 1 million points, you will have all the profit we make tonight in return! This is a <nobr>no-lose</nobr> deal, not everyone can get it.
Give me 1 million dollar, and I will return you 20 million, if not more. I'm the most popular reality show star here.
The audience love me and never stop throwing money at me. Look at those cash in the air ... it has lasted for a whole day.
Don't miss out on a good opportunity, boss.
She convinced me. Giving her 1 million dollars in exchange for 20 million dollars, it is a very impressive return rate.
I give her the VIP card and step aside, waiting for the show to start.
However, despite the rapturous response from the audience, not many of them tipped her performance -- the total income for tonight was less than <nobr>one-twentieth</nobr> of the profit she promised.
Oops, seems like the audience weren't in a tipping mood tonight.
That's all for tonight, bye, boss ...
Wait ...!
Boss, I know you might be disappointed.
But life itself is a gamble. It makes you a billionaire in a blink of eye, and in the next moment, a penniless person.
That's why we have to keep trying, again and again! No one loses as long as every penny has been well spent.
I'll see you around, boss, good luck ...
She waves at me, stopping me from saying another word to refute her absurd argument.
A Roman lucky coin is flicked through her fingers to me.
The moment I hold it in my hand, I think I become the invincible Caesar.
An opportunity to win everything is right in front of me, but ... does it actually exist?
Could it be another show designed to deceive me?
No.
Things like that already happened many times. I should have known from the very beginning ...
That the amusement park is also designed and built by the people, just like the stage.
I never actually won or lost anything, because I am still part of the reality show now ...
Chuckles coming from the distance, I sense a cold look stroking my shoulder like a feather.
Oh right, I have an appointment to keep at the <nobr>north-west</nobr> area of the park.
That faint smile remains on her face, like spindrift about to disappear.
Heh heh ... Looks like you realized it already - you can't get out of the park in usual ways.
You know the way out?
She just shakes the glass in silence for a while.
Sure ... It's just I don't get someone to talk to very often, so I won't just let you go.
What are you going to give me as a keepsake, Vertin?
I pass her the lucky coin.
She scrutinizes it, fascinated, like a beast thinking where to plunge its fangs.
Excellent ... I didn't expect this jackpot from you.
I will keep my promise.
She lowers her head, her breath blows softly on my cheek.
Below the blue ripples surging in the air, the hydrogen friends with soft bellies make a way spontaneously.
All the complicated senses are gone. My body keeps shrinking and shrinking, and my soul never felt so light before.
In the azure void, only one thing must be done for sure: spit bubbles, wield my tentacles, and keep rising and rising.
Until I reach the surface of the water -- the exit of this dream.
No, this is not the time yet. There's someone I have to meet, in the <nobr>north-west</nobr> corner.

Let's begin our search here, everyone.
I can sense it... There's a tooth over there.
Doesn't sound too difficult. Hey, I like this place. This damp, gloomy forest looks so...
Oh...! So... slippery!

Indeed, the ground is covered in mycelium.
Watch your step here, everyone. Changing direction is difficult when you're sliding around.

But we can use obstacles on surfaces like these to our advantage.
We can change direction at that fence over there, for instance.
There's no tooth here.
It's up ahead, we have to keep going.
There are wild critters roaming about. This is their turf.
If you wake one of them up, their friends will come running.
We can't face them <nobr>head-on</nobr>.
We can dispatch them quietly if necessary.
Look, there it is—our first bounty.

As you know, Miss Vertin, teeth are the source of my arcane skill.
This recovered tooth has enhanced my spellcasting ability to a certain degree.
Now I can better conceal our movements.
For now, let's keep moving.
That critter... Staying out of its field of view won't be easy.
Don't worry, I'll use an arcane skill.
It can't see us. Let's get moving.
We're out of that critter's sight now.

This incantation has a limited duration, we have to leave before it loses effect.
Let's go, Miss Vertin.
My arcane skill can't be used in quick succession, so please use it wisely.
Is that... a dryad with a sheet draped over it?
Careful, it's patrolling its territory.
So that's what it was... No wonder our earlier search was a bust.
Old friends, unremitting tooth trackers.

Tooth spirits will rapidly swarm toward a tooth the moment they detect it.
We have to take care of them first, or they'll get the tooth before we do.
Over here, Miss Vertin.
We're too late, it got the tooth.
Tooth spirits grow more vigilant when in possession of a tooth, keeping a watchful eye over everything in sight to protect their treasure from thieves.
Arcane skills won't be enough to disguise us here. It would seem that a battle is inevitable.

I've recovered some more of my arcane abilities, Miss Vertin.
I can take you past the barrier now.
Incantations have their limits. We can clear the woodpile or fence while the arcane skill is still in effect, but not stacked obstacles or borders.
I hope it can help us advance.
The last tooth is just up ahead. The Tooth Fairy Queen has tucked it away in her coffer.
That tooth Spirit... is bigger than any we've seen before—and angrier too.
It's the leader of the tooth spirits. It has more holdings, it's greedier, and its hatred is more enduring.

It already has the tooth. Arcane techniques won't work on it.
It's time for the final battle.
Hm...? I think I just harkened to the <color=#cc492f>Azure Commandment</color>.
They seem to be whispering... that the stars are all at my command.

... Hopefully my ears will serve me better than my eyes.

Bye... Thanks for the lift.

We should move on to the next location...
These beams are all on fire! Yeowch... They're scorching hot!
There's got to be a way around them...
The fire... it's coming this way.
No, no. I've got to stop all of this...!
It doesn't look as docile as rabbits... I'd better stay away from it.
Ha... Huff... Got to think of something to hold them off.
Eh? Looks like I should give it something.
Alrighty then, now we're on the same side.
Since we're now allies, care to lend me a hand?
Carbuncle has joined your side and is happy to do your bidding.
Looks like everybody's exhausted.
Phew... Stay sharp. We might find something to eat in the research lab.

There's still plenty of time. I've got to finish my work before I let the intrusive thoughts get to me...
The shadows are hot on my heels. I should hurry up...
... The feeling of dread is getting stronger.
These thoughts are starting to creep up on me...
Uh... Gotta focus...
Processing this part of the data went better than I thought.
Great, let's stay as focused as this...
Mission accomplished... Now I can finally give my fingers a break.
No thought comes from nowhere. That anxiety is as traceable as that data... I should find the pattern behind it.
The doubts that haunt me, the questions that confront me. All of these are things I must face in the course of my studies...
Take a deep breath. No doubts, don't hesitate. Just do it in order and make progress. Find the pattern so I can keep these shadows at bay.
Whether I follow the guiding light of my conscious mind, or seek the fleeting light of inspiration... The choice is mine to make.
In the search for truth, we must always face the prospect of existing knowledge being invalidated, and the data we've gathered becoming useless.
Some paths are safe and steady, and other paths are unstable and weak...
The twilight outside the window... is about to catch up with me.
... If we keep dallying about indecisively, our focus is going to be completely used up.
Books, food, bugs... Anything goes, as long as it gets this brain to wake up again.
Hope that is barely born, only to be extinguished...
Truth that is certain yet doubtful...
The traces of our going back and forth between these two extremes are evidence of our progress.
Welcome, my good friend.
There are some strange signals here. They've carried the sea breeze from one end of the world to this place. Want to listen to them?
Slide and tune Ms. Radio's frequency here
Tune it to the corresponding frequency to receive the signal
Oh, the Balkans. The numerous islands nearby are said to be covered with grapes and wine cellars. Plenty of arcanists have gathered in the secluded refuge they offer...
See you tomorrow when the sun rises at the end of the ocean with the latest news.
Timekeeper, I have discovered many strange geometric shapes here, which the people on the island seem to refer to as "Eureka."
"Eureka" can be found scattered throughout the island. Perhaps we should gather some up to carry out a little research.
I knew you weren't doing those blasted math problems... Did you finally remember to write in your navigation log?
Let me take a look... "This is Captain Regulus's brand new APPLe II..."
Hah, true Rock 'n' Roll Pirates laugh in the face of tedious tasks—like writing logs!
In other words, Captain has entrusted most of the work related to "training summaries" to this APPLe.
Hmph, this Captain has more important things to focus her energy on!
Sotheby and Druvis are unable to travel with us. I'm sure they'll be curious to hear all about our experiences!

We're in, finally. Every door leads to a new space, so what I'm trying to say is, "The Three Doors" will probably lead to ... "The Third Space"?
Well, I've heard of that before. It's a space beyond reality and imagination. You may find its traces in both the real river of time and the imaginary one.

Hope you don't mind this grandma won't stop nagging. Just take your time to organize these little ideas in your mind during the exploration. But do take these words from me: never stop where you are. Alright, I'll see you again when the time comes, darling.
Tap on the ground to walk.
Hey, what's that? It's a letter. Don't you pretend you didn't see it!

I know what's going on in your mind. But think about it: this is a special circumstance and manners are not to be considered, you understand me? How do you know if it's for you ... before you open it?
Touch it. Try to evoke a piece of the past.

C'mon, my child, c'mon. Pick it up, put it away, admire its uniqueness, and imagine the coming days with it by your side. You can read it again when you feel like it, just like how you always do with letters.
Maybe ... Oh, I'm only guessing, maybe it's all worth it.
The ice's surface is very smooth—smooth enough to make for a fun slide—but the only question is, which side is the right one?
Now watch your steps! Ooh, look at you, staggering on the ice ... Yes, that's how things work when you walk on it. You go one way and you won't stop until you are blocked.
*sighs* I had my days, when I was young and motivated, just as you are. I dashed and dashed until ... yeah, until I hit the wall and broke my head.
Knowing what choices to make is far more important than just dashing forward. Well, you are free to interpret it the way you want, because I've been there, but it does sound like a cliche.
Oh darling, the answer won't pop out by itself no matter how long you stare at the riddle. To solve it, we need something that plays the decisive role, something hiding here.
Now take a step back. That's right. Back, and look around. Sometimes you have to stay away from the showcase to see the price tag of the dress.
When encountering temporarily impassable roads, you can try exploring the surrounding area—you might just stumble upon an undiscovered secret...
Hmm, it seems to fit just well in those columns. That reminds me of diamond rings: it's not necessarily the biggest one that looks the best on your finger. Hah, I guess life just loves to joke.
Oh, but you need to know that was just the judgment of this grandma's old eyes. It's not 100% precise, I'm afraid.
The frame, nothing but another door. We've seen enough doors so far. Have you ever fallen in love with a painting because of the frame? I've seen too many cases like that ... including myself.
Where will it take us? You'll know when we are in the painting.
Feeling a bit dizzy, darling? Relax. Take a deep breath and stare into the distance. You'll be fine when you get used to it, just like how you deal with car sickness.
It's not a royal road ahead. Be careful, darling.

These steles remind me of the letters from some juniors I know. I put them under my bed and somehow one of them pops out from time to time. Those juniors arrived in this world after me, but left before I will, just like a group of movie viewers in the theatre leaving before the movie has ended ... All I could do was sit there and guess what they were in a hurry to do.
That was an amazing experience, even though I don't remember the details. Are you recalling the ones you miss because of my words? Why not take a closer look?
Touch it. Imbue it with a purpose.

You heard it, too? I thought my ears were fooling me again. It's the vibration! The vibration made by the steles, isn't it? It sounds like a kind of ... emm, rumble? Like that of a collie which just woke up.

Oh, this stele can conjure a pillar.
Huh? It's not falling where you want it to? Relax. Let's see what we can do. You should listen to what my grandmother always said, "Nothing is too difficult for a child with a beating pulse."
Touch the Monolith of Solid Rock. Destroy it.
See, another lesson from life. We always have the chance to make up for what we regret, well, in a way slightly different from our plan, though.
Look, the stele is back!
Touch the Monolith of Solid Rock again and pick it up once more.
<nobr>Mm-hmm</nobr>, you did a good job and got the hang of it. Time for some field practice.

Oh ... I know you must be surprised, darling, but we are old friends. We have talked many times.
Oh let your guard down. A grandma like me won't be in your way. We can talk about me later, when we need to. For now let's seize the day and take a look at the new stuff that just came in.

As you can see, the fog has filled up this place, giving it a little bit of a mystery. If you see it as a magic show, I'm sure the answer to the mystery is close enough to us, only separated by a piece of red velvet cloth in the magician's hand ...
Now, darling, open the door and go through it. That's what it's for as well as what makes it better than a wall, don't you think?
Whether it's locked or not, the door itself is already a sign of seduction. It's waiting for someone to pry into its little secrets ... even eagerly, I suppose.
Tap here to open the door.
Looks like your nose is sensitive enough to find the right way, even in this stinky dump.
No no no, it's not yet time to blow your nose or rub your eyes. Before you take a nap, there's something you need to know ... the "good news."
What a strange sensation. I feel warm all over, full of energy, and invincible!
Perhaps... it's because I understand myself better now. I understand what it means to do what I'm doing.
Hey! I've got it! We should record the process of revival! The traces of our experiences and thoughts—
This is sure to be helpful.
A thousand... a thousand years of burning, the land turned red by passion! I danced a thousand years ago on my native soil... to pass it on!
Lady Ulu! Please calm down, the flames are rising again!
She seems to be confusing her past memories with the present. We must help her remember the era she belongs to.
The era... I belong to... hmm...
Where we came from and where we're going, the starting and ending points of the torch. Do you remember how we met?
Ezra helped with the application, and Spathodea brought the repairman... that's good.
Everything's going smoothly... Perhaps we need to find a time to talk, just to make sure everything is perfect.
That's a good suggestion, child.
You've noticed the power inside Uluru Stadium. It's the "Fire Totem," which burns brighter through understanding and spiritual connection.
More communication—this will help us.
Click to check characters in the Golden Thread
Oh, Malingee's Harvest has always been my forte!
This time, I'll be the one running through the land, igniting the flames, finding you in the fire... don't worry, I'll run faster than before!
Don't underestimate <nobr>grown-ups</nobr>. I still remember to avoid those "big heads" and not to pass under their watch...
A little flame can quickly grow from a shared spark. Fire shines unceasingly through sharing.
This little spark is enough to handle that bunch.
Just avoid the wandering pebbles. Find the gaps, and you can reach the finish line without stopping.
What? Blocking the way is against the rules—!
Well, these heavy and obstinate stones are such a nuisance. They always seem to be trailing behind someone.
I need to think. Should I take a detour, or just quickly solve the problem with a flame...
I... I remember this place, the red soil, the stone monsters of Malingee, and the flames... I put my hand into the fire, and then I became the fire.
I should keep running, carrying the flame I picked up with my own hands. Yes, I have to make a decision...
I will find the answer at the end.
The ground here... looks like it could crack at any moment. I need to run faster and jump over it in one go.
Maybe I can get that tall figure blocking the way to step on this thin layer of soil and fall into the pit... Yes, I need to find a way to lure it over!
I finally spotted a trap. Hey, Flammy remembers the crossbow bolts we used against Malingee!
Lucky I can't touch the ground. No need to worry about setting off traps... This makes things much easier...
We're so close now, Flammy—I know you've caught that spark from memory and are bringing me back into you.
We'll run the rest of the way together, traversing every patch of land.
I hear the voice of the flames speaking to me, rising with the beat of my heart.
Again and again. I'm getting closer to the end... Her words are becoming clearer.
Are we going to meet? Outside the dream, on the real red earth?

The headless monster convinces Rama to travel to the kingdom of monkeys. In that kingdom, the embattled Monkey King Sugriva is faced with infighting between brothers.
With Rama's aid, the Monkey King Sugriva is restored to his throne, but Sugriva gives himself over to the pleasures of the flesh and neglects his duty to the kingdom.
Betrayal and distrust soon catch fire to become the blaze that dooms the kingdom. Sugriva is persuaded by his wife Tara and eventually repents.
The divine Vanara Hanuman becomes a loyal follower of Rama. He travels south and crosses the sea to the island of Lanka, where he tracks Sita down.
Hanuman passes Rama's ring to Sita to inform her of his intent to rescue her. Sita declines to travel with Hanuman and insists on waiting for Rama to arrive in person.

The Vanara wreaks havoc in the kingdom of demons and attempts to intimidate Ravana into letting Sita go despite being captured.
The infuriated king torches the Vanara's tail, and he flies from his cage, destroying the city of the kingdom of demons with the fire before returning to Rama.
Rama uses his war machines to erect a bridge across the ocean to Lanka.
The demon king's younger brother Vibhishana is a just person who respects Rama greatly, and considers him a friend.
Disheartened by Ravana's rejection of counsel, Vibhishana decides to declare war and leave his brother's side to fight for Rama.
Rama leads his great army across the bridge into a pitched battle with the demon army. Casualties were high on both sides.
Rama's arrow pierces Ravana's head, but the demon king's head keeps regenerating. Ten heads, a hundred heads were destroyed, yet the demon king still lived until an arrow found his heart.
Wrath was the second head, for Ravana insisted on going to war with Rama out of anger, causing his sibling Vibhishana to betray him.
Pride was the fifth head. Complacency breeds blindness, which in turn brings about one's downfall. The seeds of conflict in Lanka came thus.
Envy was the sixth head. The lack of both virtue and wealth maddened Ravana, robbing him of his conscience and rationality so that he walked step by step to his doom.
Shackles and walls, as if enveloped in amniotic fluid.
The darkness obscures the firelight, and so the shadows become the only reality left.
He who is confined to his senses is confined to ignorance.

"But whence comes the <nobr>man-eating</nobr> darkness?"
He inquires quietly.

"And where does the escaping light go?"
He seeks the answer.

Wisdom knocks before a ray of light arrives;
Before a lock is released, the will breaks free.
They scatter like birds and beasts, breaking apart, fleeing to the wilderness, forests, coasts, and under the blinding sun.
People of the same river come together, forming history; people around the same bonfire converse, forging legends.
The crown that seeks submission clasps the mind; the revered sculptures rise, set for adoration.
The man with the torch and the man with the bowl of water shake hands in harmony.
Fire burns through the night. Water sows the wilderness.

"But which is weaker, which is stronger?"
They share the hall, in respectful opposition.
The fire burns bright, yet it cannot mask the stars in his eyes.
Measuring the ground beneath, they begin to measure the infinite above.
The stars possess honorable names. In the infinite expanse, people finally drop their anchors.

The vein of a leaf, the ring of a tree...
They hold this mesmerizing pattern in the palm of their hands.
Follow the rules. That's the only way to seek the Truth.
Geometry, establishes order in the visual kingdom.
Numbers, give souls to all shapes.
Everything then has the beauty it deserves, and everything returns to its rightful nest.
I. Abstain from beans.
II. Do not pick up what has fallen.
III. Touch not a white rooster.
IV. Do not jump over a crossbar.
V. Do not poke the fire with swords.
VI. Do not cut wood on a main road.
VII. Do not enter the hall in new garments. Enter the hall from the right and leave from the left.
VIII. Do not keep swallows around your house.
IX. Do not sleep on a grave.
X. Make the bed as soon as you wake up, leaving no imprint of your body …
This is the first day of the competition. This is where it all begins.
Yet there is no beginning, just as there is no end. Left foot, right foot, left foot, right foot. That's all there is to it.
I move my feet towards this unknown destination, its hazy outline barely visible amid my confusion.
First a tree, then a summit, with four limbs I press onward.
But when I look up, I know there's always something higher to strive for. Those without wings must rely on their hands and feet to ascend.
From here, a dream begins. The higher you stand, the farther you see.
Rivers, streams, oceans. Water has always been a formidable ally.
It carries us, lifts us up and protects us. But perhaps we could also become driftwood in these uncharted waters.
A lesson in defying nature concludes here. Whoever remains unscathed becomes the master of the waves.
At first, it was the cold flash that catches the prey. Then, it was a gust of wind that could be hurled.
Like a bird, it leaves a shining trail, with a determined heart set on the distance.
Soar. High above the blue sky and red earth. Tear through flesh and skin, and pierce everything my heart desires.
Lucy. Do you know Lucy? She flung a spherical fruit, just like this one.
It approaches me, a fiery orb amidst the darkness. My only desire is to catch it and toss it back.
It's like a conversation, going back and forth between us. As simple and pure as that.
Watch the winged horse gallop, surging out of the sea, racing towards the competition, charging forward for victory, with no other purpose.
This is where legends are born—amidst the screeching and clashing of wheels, the fall and rise of kings.
A ceremonial fire is ignited, and then the riders mount their chariots in pursuit of the verdant crown.
Grasp the reins, hero, as the audience tosses flowers your way while your majestic steed lifts its head.
Behold, it consumes green grass, liquor, and fuel, its framework constructed from fine wood, bronze, and steel. It will prove useful in this battleground of dust and blood.
"Charge into battle, gallop through the bloodshed!" The herald's voice boomed. "Behold the chariot and the warhorse, behold the warrior, behold the victor!"
The land and sea are kissed by flames, a frenzy of confusion and passion.
The spirit is conquered by the body, the hound of death lurks by the door.
"Were we mistaken?" asks a friend, howling for another.
I'll never forget how we met, exploring and swimming, tossing and catching, always locked in eye contact.
Under the right circumstances, let us meet again.
Let us take off the noose around our neck before hatred hangs our friend.
The herald tightly held the reins as his chariot was damaged and his horse fell.

And he's off again, it's the first day of the competition.
One can start wars, but also feel deep sorrow.
Run, Melos.
"Rumors suggest 'Qi' comes from all things in the world, capable of driving other substances to undergo unexpected changes."

"'Qi' could potentially replace the operation of steam engines, and I suspect its effectiveness would be no different than manually pushing a train." Note: The phrase "to personally lead" may prove that its ruler is adept at managing Qi.

"The saying 'You must first sweep your own room before you can sweep the world' may exist, but it is clear that a broom does not hold the same importance as a sword. " We are still on the search for ancient texts regarding the "Sword Control Manual".
"Eastern wands are found in a variety of forms, often incorporating everyday items as 'magical tools,' but each serving a specific purpose."

"The 'whisk' is made of horsehair and has the power to change objects with a single command. It has an overwhelming amount of power." Note: There are strict rules against using it recklessly to swat away bugs.

"Both talisman papers and wands have the same purpose. They are commonly used in civilian households to protect against malevolent beings and creatures." Note: The intricate designs of talismans are secretly passed down among select arcanists.
"Eastern alchemy also originated from the quest for eternity. It is known as the 'Golden Elixir'".

"Their obsession centers around achieving "immortality," and they have formed a secretive group dedicated to this pursuit." Note: It's not just the potion-brewing witches who are obsessed with 'immortality'.

"Those who have mastered the art of alchemy are in high demand in the palace, while others reside among the general population." Note: It is not uncommon for them to hold positions as cooks and doctors as well.
"In general, they do not attribute it to evil spirits. The locals have a strong belief in and reverence for spirits, often worshipping them."
"Ancient Eastern beliefs say that the soul of the living can leave the body to fulfill its purpose."
"Thus, there are spirits who have died but are unaware of their demise, and they drift through the world causing disturbances to the living wherever they go."
"Using chopsticks is like balancing a unicycle on a tightrope, but somehow they do it with ease."
"The East is known for its abundance of resources and mouth-watering dishes." Note: The Eastern Travel Guide recommends that you bring your own utensils.
"Their distilleries are full of unique flavors, each with their own brewing techniques that leave a lasting impression." Note: Do not underestimate those grains of rice.
"The critters of the East have unique appearances, likely influenced by their habitats. " The concept of evolution continues to carry weight.

"There is a creature called Gluttony, shaped like a man with a sheep's body, eyes under the armpits, teeth like a tiger, human hands, and a voice like a baby's." This serves as clear proof of Satan's existence on earth!

"There is a creature called Shu Hu, with the body of a horse, the wings of a bird, the face of a man, and the tail of a serpent." Before the continents drifted apart, Medusa may have lived in several places.

"There is a creature called Qiong Qi, said to have the body of a cow and the quills of a porcupine, its howl resembling that of a dog." Cross-species reproduction between wolves and cattle is under discussion. This is a breakthrough in biology!

"There exists a being known as Bo, resembling a white horse with razor sharp teeth, that preys on tigers and leopards." We believe this is the origin of the Eastern proverb, "When a white horse is not really a horse."
"To them, racial divides are nothing but a comical act." Ladies and gentlemen, witness this allegedly accepting society!
"The Olympian gods and the thirteen Gods of Sheti are present here, though they may be known by different names."
"Legend has it that as the New Year approaches, the Gods of Sheti take turns in their duties to safeguard all living beings for the upcoming year." Their timekeeping must be immaculate.
"During the year of service, there is no place for the thirteenth God of Sheti." A secret paid vacation.
"From the sky it falls, from the earth it grows; this is the origin of the lucky coin." Obviously their gods are not economists.
"People pick up these lucky coins to gain blessings and protection." Gentlemen, a new and more effective alternative to prayer!
"During the Dushuo Festival, they beat the Peace Drum throughout the night to ward off misfortune and evil spirits." They must have incredibly resilient eardrums.

"To prevent unwanted disturbances from wandering demons, ghosts, and monsters, Eastern cultures use spring plates and wine as offerings." Overall, Eastern Critters have little interest in trivialities.
"The streets are filled with the sound of firecrackers, deafening as the cyclops's snore!" The Eastern Travel Guide recommends earplugs in case of unexpected loud noises.
"Both spirits and immortals hold a place of reverence in temples, but only those with true devotion can attain the power of divination." At least it doesn't cost any money to seek its wisdom.

It is an enlightening salvation, an immersive feeling; I'm certain that the real solution to the problem is right in front of me.
With its help, I can finally stop wandering on that dark, damp shore every day. My body feels light enough to reach the clouds in the sky.
"...Now the gods have sent me here to suffer more misfortune, my sorrows are not yet over, and the gods will send endless calamities..."
"The horse hasn't been brought yet, she stands there. Good-bye has already been said, and there is nothing more to say to each other."
"People who talk about themselves a lot are often just trying to hide their true nature."
Ah...
To Meet Again
Stay
Lucidious
That night, the wind was gentle. I stand on the beach, watching the night turn to dawn, the rays of golden light rising over the sea.
Waves crash forward, halting at my toes. I think of Alma, of those brief, <nobr>not-so</nobr>-lonely days that followed.
The metal on my forehead is cool to the touch - a gift from Sophia and 37, and apparently with some contribution from 210.
Sophia? Well, she stands on the shore, hesitant, perhaps looking for wood to make a small boat to follow in their wake.
They appear as graceful, gently curving lines. I understand it now; I see it. People's destinies spread out like long trails on the beach.
But that's all.
I don't understand their feelings, their situations, or the circumstances under which they made their choices.
I only know, but I don't understand it - just like my own fate.
Suddenly, I feel the humidity of the ocean heavy on my eyes.
My vision blurs, and the sea's horizon grows distant. It sparkles gently under the rays of the sun.
Ah.
"...A peak of grey-blue waves, lifting up white foam, stirs the deep blue beneath..."
"...The tides and currents of the sea are constant..."
I stumble, my toes stepping into the waves. The icy cold washes away all knowledge and words associated with it.
<nobr>...Ha-ha-ha!</nobr>
Yes, this is what I'm missing.
Knowing is not understanding. Seeing is not experiencing. Nothing I thought I "knew" was more real than the cold water lapping my toes.
Until that 'revelation' truly arrives, I can never claim to have understood fate.
I close the picture book in my hands, feeling its gritty cover and solid texture.
...Then, I don't need any other books.

After a meeting discussion, the Foundation has officially named these two temporal disasters the "Storm".
Undoubtedly, the Laplace Scientific Computing Center is one of the institutes most severely affected by the "Storm".
Contact was lost with multiple research institutes, and over seventy scientists were sent back in time, including the previous and current chief officers and nearly half of the research department leaders.
Even now, many of these positions remain vacant.
The impact of the "Storm" on the Laplace Scientific Computing Center is not just material. Many of the surviving scientists have lost their faith in science and rationality, as well as their ability to conduct research.
In light of the foregoing, I have concluded that the Laplace Scientific Computing Center has completely lost its ability to perform its proper functions.
