Being in a silver ocean, we need intuition, prophecy, and fantasy more than ever.
The psychological therapy of this day and age ...
Ah, you're here. I'm just organizing my observations from recent days. Look, I already have a stack of notes.
I didn't expect to meet a Mesmer here, and a "contemporary" Mesmer at that.
Although our interaction was far from pleasant ...
You know, the whole sleepwalking thing is outdated; I don't want to lie on that chair!
Sometimes, "magic" and "therapy" are just a thin line apart. Based on my own experiences, I won't deny that.
The surface of water, Orbuculum, even astrology ... I've indeed gained some new insights into identifying the inner self and helping people understand themselves.
I've heard there are also theories about dance and "healing"... perhaps my notes will grow even more.
I almost forgot, classic tales are called "classics" for a reason—evidently, the word represents a curiosity that doesn't fade with time.
For instance, your companions are clearly very curious about me.
That lady journalist with the paper bag invited me for an interview.
And Mr. Click seemed quite interested in the subject of "whether my image can be captured."
Maybe someday I'll be a legend of the city streets or a story told around a campfire in the wilderness. It's a fascinating thought in its own way.
You could say that.
I received a tea party invitation from ... let me see, Ms. Winnifred.
If she isn't here to discuss the quality of those arcanum armors, then yes, I do think some people are interested in "Semmelweis."
Shh ... Good day, Vertin. Are you here to listen to the song as well?
We can sit together, but you must be quiet, whether walking or breathing ...
The sound of flowing water is familiar to me; the sound of Mr. Straw comes from the animals; and then there are the sounds of woodwinds, strings; different languages ...
I could sit here listening for a long time.
Everyone's song is so wonderful.
At first, our languages are always not in sync.
But Mom said that one must have love and patience. And I want to say, shh ... our voices are always too loud.
Melodies flow. Each person, including you and I, are in that river.
"The Wilderness"—Is this what it is called? I have noticed that the terrain and ecosystem here are quite unique.
Any season, species, or <nobr>man-made</nobr> objects might suddenly pop up here.
From preliminary observations, I tentatively believe that the rule here is "there are no rules."
A solid hypothesis.
Considering your ownership of the space in the suitcase, and your connection to this place, I indeed plan to include your influence as a variable.
I will keep an eye on it, Timekeeper.
Indeed, randomness is property that exists objectively. Some people have a preference for this trait, which I respect.
"Unpredictable" is also an answer.
But until the hypothesis is formally proven, I believe research should not stop.
I knew it, you and I are alike, always in pursuit of the truth.
"Headonion" needs contributors like you, sir.
You mean ... you're interested in my photo?

To be fully immersed in capturing genuine images from places nearby ... that's a dream come true for every media professional who is dedicated to seeking the truth rather than pandering to the masses.
What do you think? I've heard that sightings of cows and unidentified flying objects still occur in the wilderness.
Sounds like it requires a long wait in concealment, ma'am.
Hmm ... well, good thing I'm good at that.
The tea party awaits us. Every child can be Alice!
Is this ... an invitation?
Of course. Do you prefer <nobr>berry-flavored</nobr> syrup, or <nobr>syrup-flavored</nobr> berries?
I haven't read fairy tales in a long time ... but thank you for the invitation, Baby Blue.
I will prepare well for this trip.
The <nobr>second-hand</nobr> supermarket is a great place; these sunglasses were less than one Aussie dollar.
Look at these sequins; I bet you can find equally beautiful things there.
Uh ... thank you, Desert Flannel. They are certainly ... shiny?
Hey, you're not being sincere, are you?
When you have matured as much as I have, you will learn to appreciate the beauty of sequins, rhinestones, and laser sunglasses.
So, listening to the ground is a useful skill. The earth will tell you where there are bighorn sheep, yak herds, or rivers.
I'm glad you think so too, little girl!
... Thank you, sir, I have gained much from our conversation.
You understand the character of flowing water, just as I understand mountains and wolf pups.
By the way, I have many heating techniques from the foothills that will surely help you!
So, what you have learned and remembered spans thousands of years?
... Yes.
They come from the past "6s," of which I am just one bearer.
I have also witnessed the rise and fall of several eras ... and have read fortune and misfortune in bones. But ultimately, I remain in the mountains.
So since we're both here, there's no need for me to elaborate on this experience, is there?
Exactly.
... And so, the evil demon king was defeated, and the swan maidens were freed. This painting tells that story, Ms. Hiss!
Oh, I see! Some of your letters look familiar, but others are like they are mirrored, more confusing than the Candlestick Festival flyers.
Please don't worry, Ms. Hiss!
At first, I was also intimidated in language class, but my mom said letters are our friends. Although they sometimes look stern, we can always get along if we are patient.
Ha, that sounds like something Sherjah would say. I hope these "friends" are as easy to get along with as coffee grounds.
I'm glad you understand this, Ms. Lucy! Communicating with you about logic is quite efficient.
The combination of arcane skills, ballistic projectile calculations, and logic as a way of working makes sense. I do not understand why some people confuse foresight with "superpowers."
Oh, maybe it can be attributed to people's imagination. If you're interested, I can recommend some Disks to you.
Like "The Shining Scary Hotel" or <nobr>"X-ray</nobr> Monkey Man," or would you like to try gore films? There's also ...
I respect your interests and artistic pursuits, Mr. Joshua. But unfortunately, I have no interest in such art.
Cheers! I declare this my current favorite word.
After a whole month of ascetic life in the forest, finally—my dear, unlimited Dr. Papper!
Oh, this is not to say that your energy replenishment potion is hard to swallow ...
It's okay! I am a mature lady who knows how to listen to opinions.

I'm working on improving its taste. The preliminary plan includes adding Ead's Tongue, Phoenix Tears, and the horn of a Changeling ... Once I find the right proportions, the potion can taste just like you want, even like Dr. Papper!
Why the shocked face, Regulus? No, these ingredients are only slightly more expensive than gold, not costly at all!
You ... you must be Ms. Semmelweis. Ms. Hofmann spoke of you often.
Greta has told me a lot about you as well, missy.
She has always praised your abilities, and rightly so. Your performance during the mission was exceptional.
Thank you ... No, I'm fine. I'm just...
I'm glad I could talk to you about Ms. Hofmann ... Thank you, Ms. Semmelweis.
... Is that you, Doctor?
You're here too, aren't you, kind doctor?
Did I really hear your voice, or was it just another trick of my own hysteria? Maybe my unstable nerves are feeding me lies again.
You're not here ... Doctor ... you're not here, are you?
Ms. Sotheby, did you try the potion recipe we talked about last time?
Thank you for that potion recipe! However, I'm still missing one ingredient ...
What ingredient? Maybe I can help.
If I remember correctly ... it's "deer antler."
... Strange, I couldn't find such material in the "Arcanum Creatures Material Index."
Oh ... beautiful lady, may I have the honor of asking you about some poetry?
Are you referring to me ...? Of course, I'd be happy to! What style of poetry are you interested in?
Something like expressionism, surrealism, or confessional poetry ...
Unfortunately ... I need those that are more romantic, or rather—more favored by ladies.
First mate! Get moving, I need you to plunder more loot!
First mate?
Hey, don't you dare demote me, captain!
Love ... pet ...
Oh, you really understand rock! Rock is all about screaming it out!
But which song are you singing?
Hello, hello, hello. May I invite you to my party?
I think ... no ...
I know, you must want more rainbow lollipops.
Maybe it's because there are too many rainbow lollipops ...
What an enviable Arcane Skill ...
Trust me, it's not as fun as you think.
It allows you to hear everything in the world more clearly.
Whether you want to hear it or not.
Especially, the things you don't want to hear ... those filthy secrets.
Hah! Secrets, that's exactly what I want ...
... Hah.
I agree with you. People pass judgment on new inventions too readily.
But that completely stifles inventors' creativity.
In the field of arcanum, this is unreasonable.
Aside from an invisibility cloak that only hides the clothes, I don't think any invention is useless.
Hey, kid, you should learn to respect your elders more.
Hmm? Oh, oops, sorry.
What I mean is ... would you be interested in doing a radio advertisement?
You see, a radio with its own consciousness broadcasting an ad for Critter pets.
It will certainly deepen the concept of the "Ms. NewBabel."
I don't particularly like these ... fluffy <nobr>four-legged</nobr> creatures.
What a pity. But in fact, they are quite <nobr>well-behaved</nobr>.
When you look in the mirror, what do you see?
You don't have to answer. This is not a consultation, I respect your privacy.
This is just the sudden curiosity of a friend.
Yes, this is the first thing we see when we look in the mirror.
You always maintain yourself—this is steadfast and precious.
I really wish I had your courage ...
Oh, are you describing the phenomenon of reflection?
Or, as I have always theorized, is this garden actually a reflection of some part of your inner self?
As for me, this place has flowers and wastelands, friends, and everything to accommodate change—this is a place worth stopping by, a place that belongs to you.
If I ever leave here ... I think, when I look back in the mirror, I will see this place again.
Of course, I respect your privacy.
If you ever want to talk about it, you can come to me anytime—same as with any other topic.
... Yes, as a friend.
We are all used to moving forward.
Because the only option is "no other option," and because things are not great, but not bad enough to stop either.
Interestingly, for me personally, it was I who chose my current situation.
—And you?
I'm glad we agree.
Look, under the combined influence of those choices, I have come here, and I enjoy working with you.
Until our next <nobr>life-and</nobr>-death decision comes up, right?
I think you and I already have some experience in dealing with it.
Yes, that's how it is.
I won't regret it, and through these days of cooperation, I know you won't either.
For me, that's enough, Timekeeper.
I saw my hometown, people floating in the water, people singing along with me.
I also saw my parents, they are always with me, like the water.
When we love, we will not separate, like water droplets merging.
Oh, yes, you're here too, Vertin, I won't forget you.
In the melody, on the river.
We ride on suitcases and conch shells, drifting along.
You are always here, and I am always here.
You considered my proposal to add charging stations and sensibly set them up in the wilderness, for which I am grateful.
I heard you also handled the requests of Researcher Medicine Pocket regarding walking areas and <nobr>chew-resistant</nobr> tools, as well as the suggestions for rock venues and woodland spaces.
You have become quite adept at coexisting with "differences."
Yes, I appreciate your abilities.
This place brings together many different people. Considering the space in the suitcase, the number of people, and their backgrounds, this level of difference is even greater than in Laplace.
Differences bring conflict, but also progress. Endless conformity only leads to stagnation.
Now, I am also one of your "differences."
Things that matter?
Things of interest?
About vampires?
About Semmelweis?
What are you listening to?
How do I understand it?
I am the pattern.
This is interesting.
See yourself.
See the wilderness.
Keep it secret.
I made a choice.
I had no choice.
Where?
Is this a compliment?

Why, Sophia? Why must we fight each other?!
This was preordained.
I am an irrational number, an obstacle in the pursuit of Truth. I have accepted my fate, abandoned my Scriptures, and embraced the path I should have chosen.
Let neither side hold back, 37.
No, no! This is wrong!
Three times seven equals 21.
What!? Are you making fun of my name?
White shell, <nobr>pincer-like</nobr> forelimbs ...
Ah, it deflected my arcane skill!
Vertin, it's no use attacking 21. Just focus on 9 and 33 instead!
Start with the number that has the largest absolute value: 33!
Yes, 73, a good number. It's the 8th twin prime, the 8th lucky prime ...
... and in the same combination as 37!
But sadly, you're the 21st prime number, which makes you less than perfect. Vertin, let's start with—
... With 73, because it has the largest absolute value.
Nice choice, Vertin! You are a quick learner.
Critters eating beans and a white rooster ... These are supposed to be taboos on the island.
Is this an illusion brought on by the fog? Or a new trial ...
... No, something's not right. The flow of arcane skills on the island has changed.
I need to get rid of them first.
My surroundings changed.
Is all this ... still an illusion?
What ... is this? It has more hands than all the members of a band combined!
Timekeeper, there's a gigantic creature emerging from the portal. We must complete stage two as soon as possible.
Tsk, we better finish it off before we start stage three!
Copy that. This is a critical moment. Everyone stay alert and await my command.
Is this creature changing its afflatus to match that of its attacker?
Ha, a mimic strategy. Clever. But we can also use it to our advantage.
Everyone, rotate your arcane skills! Make sure we always have the stronger afflatus! Let's teach it a lesson in improvisation!
Timekeeper, the enemy's ritual has altered the environment. Please be careful.
It has been a long time since this APPLe fell on someone's head. I assure you, this time it will not be an inspiration.
The geometry of your ritual circle is quite good, but it could use a few more triangles. I happen to have some right here. You're welcome!
Timekeeper, please allow me to assist you.
Let's rock and roll, everyone! It's show time!
Take cover. I'll send it back into outer space.
The creature is defeated, and Arcana has emerged once again. Timekeeper, stage two is complete!
Cool! Now we just have to activate it!
No. Things are going too well. Like this has been rehearsed ...
What on earth is she trying to do ...?
There's no time, Vertin!
You're right. We've put too much time and effort into this plan to not carry it out now.
Sonetto, Lilya, Regulus, assume your positions!
It's time ... to enact the final stage.
Singing for oneself and singing for an audience ... what's the difference?
You know, while rehearsing, I found another cave structure that is even more ideal for this performance.
I'm glad ... that no one left early.
The curtain has fallen ... please stay a while and listen to this echo.
Hey, this will be a bullet exhibition. Honestly, the colorful bullets often remind me of those childhood candies I could never get ...
Ma'am, what's your favorite candy effect ... oh, I mean, bullet flavor?
Ceasefire—ceasefire! My favorite shell casing has rolled away!!
Even before we started drifting, fate had already revealed today's adversaries to us.
You don't believe in fate? Yes, a beautiful flower, how could it accept the coming wither?
You have defeated me. Unfortunately, your path is still uncertain. You don't know where you're heading.
This duel concerns someone's honor.
Round Two. Someone is far from exhausted.
Someone remembers the admonition they heard when they were knighted: Never fear the enemy.
Someone admits defeat but refuses to submit to injustice.
<nobr>Y-you</nobr> again, the lady who called me a liar ...
I'm hiding here, don't come looking for me ... but don't just walk away, please ...
But, isn't it normal to protect one's own grave? Ugh ...
I've seen people like you, trying to rob us when my mom's not around ...
Take this, my mom said carrying it would bring "good luck."
The pilots are unharmed. It seems having the ability to fly prevents injuries in crash landings.
Defeat enemies to obtain the Goldfinch Coins they carry.
The enemies are prioritizing their attacks on allies with the [Exposed] status.
The enemy's Reality and Mental DEF are significantly enhanced. Delay your attacks!
"Razor" will retaliate when attacked!
Watch out! The enemy Ultimate deals more damage to characters placed in front.
Eliminate the embers quickly to prevent them from growing stronger.
When the statues are gathered together, they'll cause even more trouble.
The burning stacks on the chanter might be the key to defeating them.
Without its Sturdiness, a Monstrous Cave Eagle loses its ferocity.
Critters have bad tempers, don't disturb their sleep.
Free the Fuzzy Ball Miners from their forced labor permanently.
The statues seem to be guarding something.
A gathering of Carbuncles always spells trouble.
They are inseparable, controlling their HP disparity will simplify the battle.
Never land a critical hit; they mean no harm, except to "cool you off."
Destroy their bullets, or they'll summon reinforcements.
Don't let Charred Flower Seeds hatch successfully.
Defeating different Diviners will lead to different Morning Stars.
Watch the state of the Roaming Wanderers.
This is a "fair" duel, taunting might ease your pressure.
Make good use of Leered to leave Shrouded Ghost with nowhere to hide.
Physical attacks seem unable to penetrate the knight's armor.
The Skyline Sentries are standing by for the call.
Oh, be careful there!

Deary me, this place is in quite a state, isn't it? I can hardly recall a workshop messier than this one. The tools are spread all over the floor ... Quite a peculiar choice of location, don't you think?
But look at these installations ... Hmm. Well, it's not as complicated as it looks. We just need to direct the flow of the correct fluid into the bottle. Now let's see ...
Lucky for us, these still seem in good shape. All we need to do is rotate these pipes to form a path for the fluids to flow through.
Tap to interact with the pipes
Turn it to redirect the mixture to where it should go.
Something's missing here.
Look around. There must be some empty bottles nearby. Maybe they've been left in a corner and forgotten about.
Alright, nice and steady, now. Go grab it. The bottle filled with red fluid. Look how it shines.
Tap to pick up the elemental bottle.
Tap the pipe opening to insert the elemental bottle.
It's becoming more challenging, which is a good sign. We're probably getting close to the good stuff. Or maybe it's already here, right under our noses.
But we need the right key to solve the problem.
Alchemy is as esoteric and sophisticated a practice as can be, but mixing together a few fluids shouldn't be too difficult for you.
Since we don't have any other equipment right now, we might as well make use of this pipe ... Looks like an old reaction vessel to me.
Come, try it. We've got to start somewhere.
Oh look, here's a new trick.
If I'm not mistaken, this is a storage unit.
The good news is, we have more than enough materials to use. The bad news is, we have to use our brains again. All this thinking ... It never comes to an end!
Do you see those sections with the open ends? The fluids can flow through them.
It would be a good idea to use them to connect the pipes. Trust me, I'm sure it'll help.
Looks like the way we came, but it's a little different ...
These <color=#cc492f>signs</color> ... are they trying to take me somewhere?
The way out, perhaps.
An ethereal scorn permeates the air.
There is no option but to continue on.
The words on the wall are aiming to confuse you.
Ignore them, and follow these <color=#cc492f>notes</color>.
The trial is nearing its end, the <color=#cc492f>world under the light</color> lies ahead.
Examining the "Storm" is a daunting task that requires careful consideration.
That's why it's wise to collect and document every potential <color=#cc492f>clue</color> here for future reference.
Arcana
Now, Vertin.
Show me how you have changed since last we met.
The battlefield ... it transformed?
Prepare for engagement
Arcana is dangerous. We may not be able to defeat her.
But right now, that's not our goal.
Relax. I've got the whole battle plan all up here in my head!
I shall relegate captain duties to you for today, Vertin!
You have made new friends. Aye. Have they changed you?
Perhaps it's time you met my "old friends". Come; they await thy greetings.
Timekeeper! Arcana has disappeared, and monsters are pouring out of the portal she created!
Huh? She's running away!? That was quite the grand escape ...
No. I can sense her. She's still there, looking down at us through that portal.
She's ... waiting for something.
Everyone, it's almost time. Zeno will start any minute. We need to complete our preparations as planned and force Arcana to show up.
Easy. If we finish off all her minions, there's no way she'll just stand by and watch.
The big guy up there is mine. You deal with the rest!
Trying to gain air supremacy? Not under my watch.
I'll send that outdated hunk of scrap metal crashing to the bottom of the ocean!
Airspace cleared. Beginning <color=#cc492f>deployment</color>.
Just like the battle simulations.
I will not allow the tragedy in Chicago to happen again. Timekeeper, it's time I showed you what my training's been for.
Timekeeper, I've defeated the enemy. Beginning the <color=#cc492f>preparations</color> now.
Be careful, Captain! It appears that some abraxases are being affected by the "Storm". They are attacking indiscriminately.
Alright, then don't draw their attention. Let them attack the Manus ...
Hey! We were so quiet! Why are they coming for us?!
It seems that the "Storm" cannot entirely change their instinct.
*panting* Finally got rid of them ... Now, how am I going to deal with this ...?
Timekeeper, the first <color=#cc492f>preparation stage</color> is complete!
Great! Next, we destroy the portal ...
Marvelous, Vertin. You have put on a magnificent performance.
As a gesture of gratitude, I shall bestow unto you these gifts.
She just ... showed up of her own volition?
No, something's not right. The arcane skill in that portal is fluctuating strangely ...
She's casting a ritual! Vertin, retreat!
Hmm, no time to think!

Please follow the light. This APPLe will show you the way to the party.
Hmm, a classic irrational number. But you seem familiar.
Have we met before? In a dream, perhaps?
After the rain, the curtains of a new world is about to be drawn. But before the old world takes its final bow, the people on stage have a few words to say.
Hey, Vertin! You came just in time. Here, come over here!

Hey there, Vertin. You're back just in time.
I see that you've been doing a lot of work in the field lately.
I've been pretty busy myself, so let me show you my latest invention.
Take a look at this!
There's a machine in the corner.
<nobr>Ta-da!</nobr> The Mood Switch!
Being in the field all the time is bound to lead to burnout and fatigue, both physically and mentally.
So I prepared this for you. It can help you create an optimal resting environment when you return to your Suitcase.
It's also very easy to use. Here, I'll show you.
Through this <nobr>all-frequency</nobr> radio transceiver, you can now connect to Ms. Radio at any time, no matter where she may be!
This way, you can listen to Ms. Radio's broadcasts at your leisure. These mysterious channels must contain something of interest to you.
For the sake of the emotional <nobr>well-being</nobr> of our machines, our Mood Switch can rotate through <nobr>pre-recorded</nobr> content, giving Ms. Radio plenty of time for herself.
Besides that, it also has many other features you wouldn't expect, such as a TV, karaoke machine, optical projector, and can even serve as a barbecue grill ...
I think I'll be fine with the <nobr>radio-related</nobr> features for now.
Alright. Then please turn the knob on the left first.
Tap to switch to Connected Mode.
Oh, hello, here I am.
Simple, right? Next, we just need to ...
I've received your signal. Is that you, Mr. X? You ... I ... (intermittent static).
Hmm, there seems to be a glitch with the machine. But don't fret, a little setback every now and then is nothing to worry about.
We just need a simple, <nobr>non-arcanum</nobr> related adjustment. Please go ahead and smack it a bit up on the right side.
I assure you, everything we're doing is well within the boundaries of our safety protocols.
And I'll be sure to add this technique to the maintenance manual once you succeed.
Follow the instructions based on X's unofficial maintenance manual and smack the machine.
See? The invention was a success.
Oh, now I can hear you crystal clear. Hello, Mr. X.
Hello, Ms. Radio. I'm demonstrating this Mood Switch to Vertin. This might take a bit of your time.
I don't mind at all, happy to help.
This aligns with my own mission too.

Tap to change music.
You sure have good taste.
If you really like this song, you can mark it as a favorite here, and I'll remember your selection.
Tap to mark the song as a favorite.
It will stay saved on my memory card. And of course, you can view them and make changes whenever you want.
Here you can see all your favorited tracks.
You can also play this song to set the mood inside the Suitcase.
Play the track here.
Ahem, and this concludes the introduction to the radio feature of the Mood Switch.
What you see here is just the tip of the iceberg, believe me.
As for its other functions ...
I hope you experience the thrill of discovery as you play with the machine.
That's exactly what I wanted to say. Enjoy, Vertin.
Congratulations on discovering the Mood Switch's decryption feature. We've captured an encrypted signal!
I recommend that you switch to backup frequency I.
And I'm doing everything I can to decrypt the signal.

Before starting your journey, you need to select a Tone, which determines the strength of the enemy and the amount of credits you will earn.
The higher the tone level, the stronger the enemies and the more credits you will earn.
New Noises represent special effects created under this Tone. <nobr>Higher-level</nobr> Tones inherit all the noise effects of the previous Tones.
At lower Tone levels, any characters, Psychubes, and Resonance levels that do not meet the requirements are automatically leveled up.
Once you've chosen the Tone, it's time to choose a Catalyst for your adventure. Let's go with the "Pomegranate Heart" Catalyst for this round.
Each Catalyst has its own set of initial effects.
After selecting your Catalyst, tap here to summon your companions.
In A Series of Dusks, every character has a Clamor value. The higher the character's star level, the higher their Clamor.
When summoning characters, the total Clamor of the summoned characters cannot exceed the Summon Clamor Cap.
When starting out, the Lineup Clamor Cap is equal to the Initial Lineup Clamor Cap of the Catalyst.
You can summon up to 8 companions when starting out.
When summoning companions, you can choose to recruit an assist character, who also has a Clamor value.
Moving forward is essential to reaching your final destination.
To move forward, select a node on your current path and move toward it.
During the journey, you will gain Catalyst Essence. When the Catalyst Essence, which can be thought of as a form of EXP, fills up the current limit of the Catalyst, the Catalyst will level up.
Leveling up the Catalyst will increase the Lineup Clamor Cap, grant Potential, and allow new companions to be summoned.
When summoning companions is triggered by leveling up the Catalyst, there is a fixed Clamor Cap for that summoning session.
You can choose one or more characters, but the total Clamor cannot exceed the Summon Clamor Cap.
When a Catalyst is leveled up, the Potential gained can be used for Catalyst Progression.
At each level of Catalyst Progression, you can choose to activate one of two Potential effects.
In Catalyst Progression, only the level four effects are specific to each individual Catalyst. All other Potential effects are randomly generated.
In A Series of Dusks, the total Clamor of the deployed characters cannot exceed the Lineup Clamor Cap.
Deploy a character as a combatant.
In A Series of Dusks, you can use all the Psychubes you own.
You can configure Aiders below the deployed characters to provide additional effects during combat.
During battles, the original Tuning will be replaced with Catalyst Incantations.
Using [Catalyst Incantation] consumes Stimulus. Any remaining Stimulus from this battle will carry over to the next.
During artefact selection, you can choose and keep one or more artefacts for yourself.
You have acquired a new artefact. Tap here and have a look.
In A Series of Dusks, each artefact has its own unique grid structure.
Artefacts need to be placed on the left side, in the "Layout," to take effect in battles.
Newly acquired artefacts are automatically placed in the layout.
When there's not enough space in the layout to place new artefacts, the newly acquired ones will be placed in your "stash" on the right.
You can drag an artefact to any desired position in the layout.
By cleverly placing artefacts, you can utilize their grid interactions to gain bonus effects.
Tap on an artefact in the layout to select it. You can rotate <nobr>non-square</nobr> artefacts by tapping on them again.
After completing an area, you will enter a Safe Zone. You can tap on the pieces in the zone to interact with them.
You can review artefact exchange recipes on the left side of the screen.
The exact requirements for each item are listed to the right.
After the exchange, the required materials will disappear, and you will receive the target artefact.
Steps Forward

When the bricks crumble,
Amidst the sound of hurried footsteps,
The heartbeat of energy, orderly and rhythmic.
She still gazes,
At the distant fire that illuminates everything.
And within that fire is the ladder to tomorrow.
The Fighter's Best Wishes

The moment of decision has come. Farewell, my friend.
I will forever bless tomorrow,
Hold hope in my heart for you,
And pour out all my remaining courage upon my homeland.
That shaded path, those halls, that golden circuit that bears me.
Approaching Rain

<nobr>Tick-tock</nobr>, time slips into the water;
The clouds collide and descend,
Sweeping through this fleeting moment,
All things in the world suddenly perceived.
Where is she? Where is she going?
In the Shadow

Walking through the deepest shadows, under the intense sunlight,
She disappeared. Not behind, nor beneath.
Not in photos, nor in the mirror,
Only you see her, holding her hand.
Going Along Alone

The Potomac River flows silently.
Father, oh Father.
The grassy field and white crosses have stood for hundreds of days and nights.
I will set off, I will travel far, my wings are not yet strong, my future unknown.

Rowing!
On this day, Eastern people row boats, even on land! This conjures images of Viking longships. Could it signify a connection between Easterners and Vikings? The editor will continue to investigate.
Preparing magical potions

Mugwort and calamus leaves, no need for dragon hearts or phoenix feathers, just common herbs. Burning them brings good fortune and wards off evil spirits—what exactly are these evil spirits? Must investigate further.
Wearing <nobr>five-colored</nobr> silk threads

Wearing <nobr>five-colored</nobr> silk threads on this day also represents good luck. Four colors might represent the four elements, but what about the fifth color? Perhaps Easterners discovered the fifth element before Aristotle? The academic world is astonished.
Strictly guarding food!

On this day, Easterners wrap a special type of rice called "glutinous rice" in plant leaves, steam it, and then throw it into water. Why do they throw food into water? Find out in the next installment …
A shocking and terrifying truth!

According to Eastern movies, glutinous rice is a weapon against undead spirits. Combined with warships and blessing rituals, smart people should realize—this day commemorates the Easterners' battle against certain underwater undead spirits. A terrifying truth.

Work and Days
"As Homer Said"
—Excerpts from a Newcomer's Notes

This is my tenth day here. The island greeted me today with a clear morning imbued with the moist, salty breath of the sea. I woke to the cry of seabirds, realizing I had adapted to the rhythm of life here faster than I imagined: it was sunrise, and I found myself naturally reflecting on the lecture from the day before. As the teachings of the school suggest: awaken with the Star of Apollo, reflect on yesterday's deeds, and plan today's tasks.

Attracted by the gentle sea breeze blowing through my window, I decided to take a walk on the beach before breakfast. By now it was no longer a challenge to find my way through the elegantly simple white buildings built in precise patterns. I followed a sweeping curve toward the shore, wondering what function this path might serve. Soon the neat pebbles underfoot gave way to soft sand, and the cries of the seagulls mingled with the unique hissing sound of the Abraxases—I guessed they were soaring above the distant cliffs. I stepped onto the gravel, quickly becoming lost in my thoughts.

At the School of Apeiron, mornings are for strolling through the fields. Apparently, I wasn't the only one who preferred the beach for my walk. A quiet young disciple walked by, kindly pausing to touch my hand and greet me with a gesture. I smiled back, preserving the quiet moment. Not long after, two other members of the school, deep in discussion about a number theory problem, almost collided with me, so engrossed were they in their conversation. I wandered aimlessly, letting my thoughts guide my steps, contemplating my recent experiences.

"Perhaps I should stay on this island a bit longer?" I said to myself.

Of course, the only answer was the incessant sea breeze.

Unconsciously, as the cool seawater lapped over my feet, someone beside me spoke up: "You're about to step into the sea, ma'am." I recognized her hoarse, authoritative voice.

I stopped and thanked the kind Custodian. She led me to a place safe from the tides. For a moment, we faced the ocean together.

"Is it the color of wine?" The words of a poem I had read long ago came to mind, and I suddenly spoke them aloud. Please forgive me; it wasn't meant to be presumptuous. On this island, I seemed to recall all my <nobr>long-forgotten</nobr> knowledge of ancient Greece.

"What did you say?"

"Sorry, I just suddenly remembered Homer's description of the sea."

She shook her head. "No, I think it's just blue. Just blue."
Maze Garden
"The Meanderings of the Wall"
—Excerpt from the column essay "The Mysteries I Know"

I remember the first time I saw a maze in a children's picture book. On the flat pages, the winding lines created complex circular, diamond, or <nobr>bird-shaped</nobr> walls. The possibility of getting lost terrified and inevitably excited my young self, and I immediately began the adventure, pencil in hand.

Of course, at the age of five, I had never heard of Theseus, the fearsome Minotaur, or the wise Princess Ariadne. Looking back now, the lure of a meticulously woven puzzle that compels one to venture within its winding walls seems like an irresistible temptation that spans millennia. Dear readers, allow me to make an irresponsible conjecture: when the genius architect Daedalus (who, according to some legends, was actually an arcanist—how fitting!) accepted King Minos's invitation to build the world's most famous labyrinth, he must have anticipated the hidden dangers of the task. Still, the opportunity to create such a puzzle with his own hands was clearly too tempting to resist.

As my loyal readers are aware, I have spent many years observing and studying those we call "arcanists." Forgive my rambling, but the above recollection of mazes is not entirely unrelated. To my knowledge, in the field of arcanum, regular shapes and lines (or "arrays") generally guide the smooth operation of spells. Proper shapes can enhance the effectiveness of arcanum, or alter and transpose its properties. Constructing these shapes as large, immovable entities is undoubtedly one way to preserve the spell.

From the labyrinths of Crete and those described by Pliny the Elder in Italy to the towering labyrinth gardens of Schönbrunn Palace, how many mazes bear the marks of arcanists? In today's society, is there still a small island somewhere like Crete that houses an unfathomable arcane labyrinth? For more insights and speculations about the arcanum, please continue to follow my column ...
Star of Apollo
"The Gods of Delphi"
—Excerpt from Notes Stained with Deep Purple Marks

According to mythology, the former ruler of Delphi was a giant serpent named Python, who occupied the local spring until he was slain by Apollo. Apollo then built his temple and made this place his base for delivering oracles. Aeschylus believed that the oracles of Delphi originated from Gaia, the Goddess of the Earth, and the legend of Python may symbolize the replacement of primordial earth mother worship with Apollo worship. Quick note: He drove away his great-grandmother's pet! What a remarkable young man. In another legend, Zeus released two eagles to the east and west to measure the earth, and the two eagles eventually met at Delphi. Therefore, a stone pillar was erected at Delphi, carried by two golden eagles, to commemorate this event that made this place the center of the earth. The stone pillar is called "Omphalos," meaning the navel of the earth. Quick note: Obviously, the king of gods needed a more accurate means of measurement ... The priestesses of Delphi were known as Pythia, and they gave oracles to the people during the Apollonian festivals. Not every question could be answered by the gods; it was up to the priests to decide which questions could be accepted. One method of judgment was to pour cold water on a goat offered as a tribute by the questioner; if the goat did not tremble, it was considered a bad omen, and appropriate rituals had to be performed immediately. Quick note: For the goat, living an extra quarter of an hour is indeed a great blessing. Tomorrow's sermon topic is set—ancient texts and traditions. Just thinking about debating with 888 makes me wish I were telling jokes to our great leader instead. In some legends, for three months each winter, when Apollo went north for purification, Delphi was taken over by the wine god Dionysus. During this time, oracles were given in the name of the wine god, intertwining the divinities of the sun god and the wine god. Quick note: "On the Worship of the Wine God within Sun God Worship," a good topic for a public lecture. At least, it looks good now—hoping that after the effect of the wine, I still think so. 37 thinks I ate too many grapes. Yes, she is a child of Hermes. I don't expect her to understand this, but I now need the spirit of the wine god ...

The Awakened
"Understanding The Awakened"
——Excerpt from LSCC Internal Documents

... Congratulations, dear future colleague, you've almost finished this boring little booklet.

Considering that you've stepped through the gates of Laplace— which means there's a 95.7% chance that you're as much of an oddball as I am, and almost no one here cares about your social etiquette—I didn't originally plan to include a "relationship advice" section in this manual. I think you'll agree with me: that sort of thing is more appropriate for elementary school classes.

However, given the diversity of members here, I'm sure you don't want to unintentionally offend a potential supervisor within the first five minutes of meeting them. So here are some useful tips:

1. Honest Communication. They may not have a biological sex, they may think of themselves as a toaster, and they are a toaster. But make no mistake about it, they are still a valued colleague of ours. If you're not sure how to communicate with them, just ask them.

2. Respect Beliefs. What constitutes a life belief, and how to find them—this topic easily veers into the realm of philosophy. But generally, The Awakened often have goals or beliefs upon "awakening." I must admit that having a natural sense of purpose is something I envy. And I'm sure I'm not the only one who feels this way.

3. Understand Commonalities. Hey, since we're all oddballs, let's be real—there's no difference between a colleague who needs regular electricity or winding up, and a colleague who periodically ingests copious amounts of caffeine to stay awake. If your colleague is incapacitated by a lack of electricity, being considerate and bringing a charger is as appreciated as bringing coffee and a sandwich.

—Well, in summary, all the weirdos welcome you and hope you keep all your limbs intact during your first week at Laplace!

I got a very cute stuffed animal for Christmas once when I was five years old, I think. Oh, if I remember correctly, there should be an old photo! I was sitting next to the Christmas tree with snowflakes on my head and a big grin on my face. Next to me was a particularly well-behaved little bear with a tail longer than any other teddy bear's. It was incredibly cute and I took it with me wherever I went.

On every sleepless, hungry night, on every night my parents fought, on every night when the cold was unbearable, I'd hug it tightly because it was so warm and soft. As long as I could hold it, everything didn't seem so bad. It was so important to me; I always thought it was my first and last friend.

Until the day my mom held my hand and led me, nervous and fidgety, through the doors of the Velvet Restaurant.

It was then that I realized I might have something just as important as the bear in my arms—a delicious cake, a soft, thick blanket, a home that sheltered me from the wind and rain.

Today is the eighth Christmas of my life, and unlike past years, I received another carefully prepared Christmas gift. Even though I know that the bow on the wrapping paper wasn't tied by the big guy himself, I'm still very happy! He gave me a blue scarf, saying it matched the color of my eyes. Considering how pretty the scarf is, I'm willing to forgive his cluelessness in not knowing blue from green. But who asks someone what they want for Christmas next year? No sense of romance at all.

Of course, I already know what I want for next Christmas! A bigger, warmer home that can fit a bigger family, one that's even bigger than Haight Street!

Belonging to Mercuria, this healing box contains incense, candles, and potions—everything you need for maximum effectiveness.
Cateye Wisen

A young pickpocket from the suburban trailer park. With sharp cat-like eyes, nimble hands, and a pair of muddy, tattered canvas shoes, the young Wisen has managed to snatch meal after meal without getting caught.
Order of Enlightenment · Elite
A follower of the Order of Enlightenment, an elitist who holds arcanists in the highest regard. A youth bathed in self-bestowed glory, captivated by the changing times and driven by new ideologies.
Order of Enlightenment · Elderly Woman
A follower of the Order of Enlightenment, an elderly woman skilled in alchemical potions. She enjoys guiding humble young people and is adept at making insolent brats shut up for good.
Order of Enlightenment · Apprentice
A follower of the Order of Enlightenment, a beguiled enthusiast of potions. Once caught in a maelstrom of skepticism, she is now at peace, awaiting the revelations to come.
Order of Enlightenment · Senile Fool

A follower of the Order of Enlightenment, a dangerous old man obsessed with the arcane. His obsession with forbidden knowledge sustains what's left of his life, and his faith fills his aging body with renewed vitality.
Mutated Glawackus
A special breed, secretly domesticated on the black market. They have developed a powerful desire to tear their prey apart in the midst of darkness.
Legers the Dead

A notorious figure in the mafia world, known for his control over San Francisco. After pulling the trigger for the first time, he felt an overwhelming rush of control and dominance. The feeling was addictive, exhilarating, and impossible to forget.
Horn and Tail Enveiled

A manifestation of consciousness. Shrouded in a hazy mist, it takes on an elusive, indistinct form. Its appearance is reminiscent of the totems worshipped by followers, its figure resembling the decaying remnants of the night. Born in the labyrinth of a mysterious god, it seeks absolution in a world plagued by sin and depravity.
Flickering Image
A creature drawn to the brilliance of the mirror ball. This is not only a response to light, but also an innate desire to pursue ideals.
Vinyl Collector
A renowned record collector. He has spent his entire life searching for the perfect black vinyl. Finally, he can proudly display his most prized possession.
70s Collection
Items stored in a beautiful antique cabinet. Even something as mundane as a radio can be transformed into a magical tool, making even the most basic of wands seem unremarkable in comparison.
80s Collection
Items stored in a beautiful antique cabinet. It almost seemed to have a personality of its own, standing as a grand centerpiece for the stack of records below it.
Rhythmic Host
The master of ceremonies on stage, an essential presence at any costume event. Unlike a certain pirate radio host, she takes a more reserved approach to her performances.
Dressed Note
A loud, boisterous Critter that snuck in without anyone noticing. Its face is adorned with a splash of colors, its attire seems deliberately chosen.
Confused Note
A loud, boisterous Critter that snuck in without anyone noticing. Do not try to ask it questions, or you will be met with a puzzled and confused look.
Excited Note
A loud, boisterous Critter that snuck in without anyone noticing. It's unclear if Critters have the ability to understand music, but that doesn't seem to stop them from having a good time.
Devilish Godfather
A godfather who is trying to keep up with current trends. While it may seem harsh, his preference will always be for classical music alone.
Generous Sage
The first sage to bestow blessings. He brings endless wealth, praising the children born during an era of abundance.
Zealous Sage
The second sage to bestow blessings. He sends a peaceful breeze, praising the child born during an era of tranquility.
Visionary Sage
The third sage to bestow blessings. He offers grand ideals, praising the children born during an era of chasing their dreams.
Tardy Sage
The sage who arrived late. He missed the gift-giving, so he decided to seize the moment and took control of the era and the children's evening with a lively dance.
Painter of Red
Known as the city's master of black. His canvas of choice is always black, and with splashes of red watercolor, he creates mesmerizing works of art that leave viewers in a state of awe.
The collector of black objects in the city. She has seen all of the city's finest works, and not one has evaded her grasp in adding to her own personal collection.
Bill Deliverer

She is the one tasked with delivering the family's "bills." Does she arrive quietly? Is she always there? Is she unshakable? Yes, all of these descriptions fit her and the thin black envelope she carries, a symbol of the family's financial responsibilities.
Dovecote Overseer

A talented overseer of executions. The story always begins with a young boy arriving in the city, staying on Haight Street, then leaving and vowing to make a name for himself. And now, he has succeeded.
Dovecote Executioner

A proficient executioner. He is satisfied with his job: reasonable workload, good pay, and it allows him to fully utilize his talents. However, he can't help but question if his position is truly secure.
Healed One
At first, he dismissed crystal healing as just another fad. But as he held the small, beautiful stone in his hand, a wave of calm washed over him, bringing back memories of a carefree childhood.
Herb Guardian
A massive creature that lives in symbiosis with herbs. Its tracks serve as a signal for the presence of rare plants nearby, but also warn of potential danger in the area.
Classic Healing Doll
An arcane doll used in sacred healing ceremonies. Don't worry, it's just a simple combination of cloth and stuffing ... What? You're telling me it's actually moving?
Soar for Me
A special healing doll with a pair of imaginary wings. Used to mend the shattered aspirations of those who dreamed too high, like a modern-day Icarus.
Practitioner
A master of inner peace, he understands the universe through his calloused palms. The stars and specks of matter communicate with him, and he responds in his own unique manner.
Mind Effigy
An idolized representation that surpasses the limitations of perception and thought. In the ever-changing universe, rebirth is an integral part of its constant renewal and cycle.
Mars Observer
A dedicated astronomy enthusiast with a fascination for Mars. The dryness of the planet serves as a constant guide, whether in the pursuit of astronomical knowledge or personal destiny.
Saturn Observer
A dedicated astronomy enthusiast with a fascination for Saturn. The moistness of the planet serves as a constant guide, whether in the pursuit of astronomical knowledge or personal destiny.
Ex-Sommelier

A man who had the misfortune of losing his job because of a careless remark. A few thoughtless statements that he believed were meaningless, resulted in him being transformed from a respected sommelier to a homeless person living under an overpass.
Red-Crested Biker

A motorcyclist with a rooster-shaped helmet. As they ride along California's Highway 1, the gentle ocean breeze causes their bright red crest to flutter in the wind, making them stand out on the road.
Underground Bruiser
A henchman who lurks in the shadows, hiding his brass knuckles at his side. His most trusted companions are strong whiskey and the handmade weapons he carries.
The Esteemed Judge
A judge is the embodiment of justice. They do not need to forge new swords, for the concept of justice remains consistent throughout time.
Silver Plating
The set of silver armor has endured countless trials, but it still stands strong. The accompanying sword is a formidable weapon, capable of mending and honing itself for each new challenge.
Gold Plating
The set of gold armor has endured countless trials, but it still stands strong. The accompanying sword is a formidable weapon, capable of mending and honing itself for each new challenge.
Metallic Soul

A fierce warrior spirit encased in a metallic shell. It roars and rages, then struggles to catch its breath. The countless battles it has endured have sharpened its will, demanding total devotion from those who forged it.
Coastline Angle

The Bay Area coastline curves gracefully, revealing a golden angle that only seasoned photographers and mathematicians can appreciate. This hidden beauty of the coast is often overlooked by casual observers.
Nymph of Flowers
A modern fairy tale that has gained popularity. It makes its appearance exactly at 5:55 AM. Do not get too close, take pictures, or make any wishes around it.
Dolphin Plush
A popular toy sold by street vendors. Its plush form and elegant design perfectly match the beauty of the golden city by the ocean.
Portable <nobr>First-aid</nobr> Crate
Parents of playful children rely on this compact medical kit. A child who manages to win a race with nine sharp turns is bound to have some scrapes and bruises.
Coastal Guardian I
A Model I security robot that patrols the shore day and night. It is a reliable machine with no recorded incidents or failures, making it the perfect choice for customs guards.
Coastal Guardian II
A Model II security robot that patrols the shore day and night. It is a reliable machine with no recorded incidents or failures, making it the perfect choice for customs guards.
Stowaway's Nightmare
A detection sentry along the coast, working around the clock to deport any unwelcome visitors.
Prison Suppressor I
A Model I security robot used in Alcatraz Prison. Once the third red warning light flashes, it switches from "Alert Mode" to "Sedation Mode," escalating the level of response.
Prison Suppressor II
A Model II security robot used in Alcatraz Prison. Once the third red warning light flashes, it switches from "Alert Mode" to "Sedation Mode," escalating the level of response.
"The Ultimatum"
A mega suppressor used in Alcatraz Prison. When all else fails, it serves as an all-out ultimatum.
Rock Revivalist
An artist promoting the resurgence of rock music. She leaves graffiti of iconic bands on the back doors of numerous clubs, proclaiming the return of the rock era.
"Voices of the Streets" Radio
A mysterious source of sound that broadcasts through the streets and alleys. The "Voices of the Streets" radio station shares the freshest interpretations of modern graffiti with its listeners.
Transistor Core
The computational core of the electronic kingdom. A crucial target for protection during any major earthquake, and a source of worry for countless shareholders.
"Kindhearted" Dealer
A conspicuous illegal merchant that lurks the streets and alleys, ready to make deals. You may be pleased at first, but that satisfaction will only last until the transaction is completed.
Hourly Wage Worker
A wide variety of temporary jobs can be found on this bustling street filled with outsiders. Hourly wage workers are always in abundance here.
Opera Fanatic
A cryptic horror story that belongs to in the darkness of night. The sorrowful melody echoes in the background, haunting the youth who just want to party.
Street Preacher

A young woman passionately delivering speeches about social issues in the streets. Her beliefs in the New Age movement have gained her a large following, although many of them only seem to know how to chant slogans without truly understanding their meaning.
River Diviner
A diviner who speaks with the rivers. The waves lap against the shore as she watches, seeing for the first time the convergence of thousands of rivers.
Herb Guardian's True Form?
A Critter that forms a symbiotic relationship with herbs, sometimes camouflaging itself in the process.

West Coast Streets

The second millennium of the Gregorian calendar draws to a close amid prosperity and revelry. Mass media, electronic entertainment, and worldwide disco culture have finally made this vast world smaller. My dear, here we have the Internet, globalization, and the new gospel of the Information Age!

Under the frenzy of disco lights, skyscrapers rise across the West Coast, just as this era that will mark the end of history reaches its peak. The city's chasms tear the two societies on the same land asunder—an economic boom, the rich get richer, and the poor get poorer. Beyond the glossy world governed by laws and regulations lies an underground society created by the people themselves.

After all, this city never lacks immigrants and wanderers who are shut out by the mainstream.

"If you're homeless, go to Tang's Restaurant, J and his pals will find you a job."
Haight Street Beats

"Backstreet Boy" J's whistle is faster than a cop's baton. Listen, just listen—if you hear him blow one long, two short, three times, it means, hey, the cops are coming! Get out! And if it's one short, two long? Hey, it just means the weather's nice, and J's whistling for the heck of it! "Black Hand" Sergeant As long as J solves more trouble than he causes, he's considered a good guy on Haight Street. This isn't a matter of law enforcement, it's simple math—addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, that's all it is. Immigrant Vendor I swear by my own conscience and the ancestors back home, it was Mr. J and the Sergeant who took down the Snakehead Gang. The cops hogged the headlines, and the papers didn't mention a word about Mr. J. What a disgrace! How do I know? Duh! He personally saved me from that ship!

Pandora Wilson: I see. So, metals and grains did play a crucial role in the development of our civilization ...
Pandora Wilson: In that sense, I think I understand what you mean ...
J: If you ever need a knife, you know where to find me. I've got plenty of good stuff for you to choose from—
Pandora Wilson: Thank you, but I don't think I'll be needing any of those sharp and dangerous tools.

This Thriving Era

The turmoil of the real world has left the hearts of the younger generation scarred and battered. They wander, seeking a refuge for their souls, only to be torn apart by the harshness of war and the vast chasm created by economic prosperity. Lost and uncertain, they pause, turn inward, and begin to focus on the self.

Fortunately, this turmoil has brought about a diverse fusion of spiritual cultures. People are drawn to each other, gathering together and finding a way to sit down again. They follow their beliefs, sharing both their inner peace and their pain, temporarily forgetting the shadows cast by material civilization. In a return to nature that is both free and innocent, they embrace equality and love. They know how to listen, are open to acceptance, and so ideas from all over the world merge and intersect, leading to a flourishing of new movements. The New Age movement has become a haven for the release of pain and confusion.

Surrounded by a circle of short white candles, Mercuria gently touches the astrolabe, listening to the stars twinkle beneath the rousing synthesizer music. Lights flicker on the stage as passionate young people expend their overflowing energy with abandon.

"You're up next! Sweetheart, do you know what they call you? Miss Heaven! Hah!"

Mercuria snuffs out the candle flame, stands up, and the crowd below fervently chants her name.

"Because this is a night worth looking forward to," she says, stepping into the roar of the crowd.
The Longest Stay

"Sara."

The gathered energy surges through the air. It is known as the Matron of the Orphanage.

"Sara!"

I forgot—it can't see me like this, so I have to...

"I'm here." I said, opening my mouth, and my eyes. I see the dust, visible in the light peeking through the crack of the door, then, the darkness, and high on the wall was a skylight, and the stars outside were dense and bright.

"Sara? Sara?"

The Matron's footsteps grow more hurried as she walks down the long corridor, up the cold, splintered metal stairs, and walks across the moldy, dusty floor. I leave the hard, uneven cement ground, brush off the particles clinging to my skin and clothes, turn the cold iron handle, and listen to the sharp, grating sound of the rusty lock.

"You're here." The Matron saw me, her eyebrows raised, pupils round, lips slightly parted. After a brief moment of shock, she quickly approaches me. She pulls me into her arms, wrapping me in her embrace, and I feel her warmth through the rough fabric she wears.

"This is not two worlds," she says.

"This is not two worlds," I repeat.

I gently stroke the Matron's waist, the place where her energy is strongest.

"Oh, my child ... you don't understand." She pulls away to look into my eyes, her eyebrows furrowed, her gaze slightly distorted, and her lips pressed together under lumps of lipstick—her energy is tense, which means she's not feeling well.

So I hug her too, wrapping my arms around her, letting her feel my warmth.

"Am I right?" I ask. "Am I in your world now?"

"No ... do you still remember what I taught you? You have to layer what you feel over the world you see."

The Matron's eyes still hold tears, her lips turned down in an expression of sadness and pain, but I don't answer her, because I see her energy is no longer tense, but full and saturated, like branches drenched in water.

I think I've found the secret to balance.
A Journey Without a Destination

Pandora Wilson: You're quite the unique individual, not like most people I've met before. They usually embark on journeys to find something, like a new cultural experience, breathtaking views, or even a chance at romance.
Mercuria: Hmm.
Pandora Wilson: So, what motivated you to start your journey?
Mercuria: A map, Christmas Eve, and an open door from the Matron.
Pandora Wilson: Sounds like the beginning of a children's adventure movie.
Mercuria: Hmm. Yes.
Pandora Wilson: Yes?
Mercuria: They loved the story, although what some might call "artistic embellishment" was added.
Pandora Wilson: Ah yes, the need for dramatic effect. Some people won't believe a story unless there's some embellishment.
Mercuria: Actually, that particular family didn't allow me to stay the night after hearing my story.
Pandora Wilson: ...
Pandora Wilson: ...
Mercuria: Hello? Are you still there?
Pandora Wilson: Of course, "artistic embellishment," a very cliché technique.
Pandora Wilson: Have you ever thought about how your journey will eventually come to an end?
Mercuria: When that time comes, I will simply stop.
Pandora Wilson: You seem very calm about it all.
Mercuria: I have accepted it.

City of Gold

For San Francisco in the 1980s, the once bustling ports that facilitated the exchange of countless goods had become obsolete, like an umbilical cord ready to be cut. Just as a newborn needs milk, the city has been reborn, nourished by capital, as the service and innovation economies replaced old industries, becoming its new sustenance. Emerging multimedia and tech companies, venture capital investments, and the rapidly rising real estate market—these fresh toys hang over the crib, capturing all of the baby's attention.

The shopping mall is one of these toys. It has long passed its exploration and development phase; now, the "big players" want to add more elaborate icing on the cake.

Hundreds of stores offering different products? All here.

Luxury hotels? Of course.

A water park? Why not?

A mini-golf club? Sure, why not?

Swimming pools, a scenic lake stretching hundreds of feet, and even a church—solemn, entertaining, and even provocative. Here, people won't need to worry about how to spend their money. As its name suggests, this is the center and gathering place for wealth and material desire.

It is here that the Pioneer was born. He is a product of the showcase, a product of the social elite, a product of money.

Yet he is more than just that.

A Letter to Associates

I have finally arrived at the location of my mission, San Francisco! The streets are constantly bustling and noisy, thanks to the nearby bars blasting music all day and night. The New Age Market is a gathering place for many arcanists, though I doubt any of them could match my abilities. It was clear that such a complex environment would require the talents of a distinguished investigator like me. My accomplishments will make their way to your ears soon enough!

Oh, by the way, I found some goodies at the New Age Market, which I've included in this letter for you all to enjoy. Don't forget to share them with Sonetto ... I mean, everyone!
Clash 'n' Slash

Phew. How many times has it been this week?
The Order of Enlightenment is like a never-ending infestation in my house—they just keep popping up.
They're always up to no good. Like pests, they need to be driven out.
Running around the neighborhood like this every day, I can feel the pounds just melting off. Maybe I'll treat myself to some big tacos and burritos to make up for it.
Again?
I don't hate tacos and burritos; in fact, I enjoy them every once in a while.
But eating the same thing for an entire week? That's too much. How about we switch it up and get some Chinese food instead? Maybe some chow mein?
Thank you all for your continued help. What would you like for lunch? My treat.
Ms. S, I've been curious about something for a while now.
Hmm?
What's your full name?
Well ... You can just call me Ms. S, just like everyone calls you J, even though your full name is Joe Brown.
I'm just curious, and since we're practically best friends, Ms. S, it's not right that we only know each other by nicknames.
Oh? Maybe you could take a guess? If you get it right, I'll buy you lunch for a week. If you get it wrong, it'll cost you a nickel.
Hah, interesting. Savina!
I'm sorry, but you're wrong. That'll be five cents, please. I doubt you'll be able to figure this out.
Sarah?
Are you guessing too, Mr. Becket? But I'm sorry, that's incorrect as well ...
Space.
Oh, I like that word. But even though you're still mistaken, I'll let it slide this time and not make you pay the five cents.
Satellite.
... You're getting closer!
Surround! Sneaky! Scramble! Split! Surrender! Did I get any of them right?
... I give up. Just call me Sputnik, guys.
Is this your first time, kid? You're about to get your a** handed to you, so don't run crying to mommy when it's over, all right?
*sigh*
What's the matter? Getting cold feet?
Too bad, man. You look a lot like the protagonist of *Somebody up There Likes Me*, just in looks, though.
That's a great movie, man. You should check it out. It sucks that I have to mess up that face of yours in just a moment.
You little punk! I oughta knock your teeth out right now, maybe that'll teach you not to run your mouth!
Don't get too cocky now.
What if you lose?
What if I lose?
Then you owe us a month's worth of burritos! How do you like the sound of that, Becket?
You hear that, buddy? My meals for the next month are riding on you!
#$!@ you guys!
Why don't you guys save yourselves some energy? You can't outrun my ride.
So, where are you headed? Let me give you a lift.
Just go ahead and kill us! We're not telling you squat!
But don't get it twisted, pal. I'm not evil or anything.
I'm not gonna off you.
Plus, someone's gotta live to tell your boss what went down, am I right?
W-We're out here looking for some dude called J. He's been messing with our boss and we gotta take him down ...
But other than that, we haven't been anywhere and don't know jack!
... Why don't I be the one to tell your boss what went down instead?
I don't think you're cut out for this line of work. Better start looking for something else, amigos.
Even though that weird light orb is gone, at least the burritos still taste the same as before.
You like the burritos that are spicy as hell?
Is there something wrong with your taste buds? You're as strange as those people who keep shouting about the color of energy.
You're one to talk. Don't you run to the New Age Market every day to drink those weird free drinks?
First of all, that's not strange at all; second, they're not free drinks, it's called HEALING HERBAL TEA!
McCloud told me the ingredients include sage, lavender, and some kind of black fuzz—apparently, drinking it puts you straight into a meditative state.
Wait, hold on a sec, what's that black fuzz? Don't tell me it's ... fur from a Critter?
Don't say stuff like that, it's gross!
Then take a look at the little guy flapping around at your feet now.
Damn it! It's your fault they're here. Critters are way harder to deal with than cockroaches!
Stop yelling and give me a hand, let's get rid of this thing!
Here you are, it wasn't easy for my men to find you.
What's the matter?
I want to confirm something again. What does my energy look like right now to you?
You're filled with red energy, like a newborn baby just coming into the world, unbaptized.
You've been reborn.
So today is the day of Legers the Dead's resurrection. I guess I should buy some flowers to celebrate.
You've earned a favor from Legers, so tell me, what should I do to repay you?
Do what you want to do, and then your energy will reach the orange of dawn.
What I want to do ...?
Exactly, a burrito is perfect for a newly reborn Legers, even if I might take a few hits for it.
But I think Legers deserves it.
Stay calm ... Sotheby, stay calm ...
Think about what the bodyguards would do ...
You're facing a real gun right now ... The only thing you need to do … Is be faster than it!
Eroj Exchange!
Good! Well done, the gun barrel has been swapped for a coffee cup! Now...
Oof! What's this feeling ... Ugh ... I feel dizzy.
*Cough* *Cough*... Fool ... You drank the old hag's coffee.
What?
The old hag's coffee ... it saps the strength you're supposed to have. One bottle and you're teetering on the edge, two bottles and you're sent straight to heaven!
Is it really that powerful? What's in the recipe?
You ...!
Boss! This kid's like a rat! He's scurrying in between those boxes, we can't catch him ...
Looks like we do this the hard way, J. Don't blame us for breaking nothing.
Come out you little rat. I got my eyes on you.
Have a little dream with me, cutie pies.
What the hell is this monster?! Is this thing the girl that was just here? Hell of a transformation!
Something here is very much not right ... This smoke, it must be from her arcane skill! It seems to be affecting us somehow!
Get back! Stay away from me! This sword's got a mind of its own, and it ain't happy!
Boss! She uh, she's moving!
Watch yourselves!
How about we get a little bit more up close and personal?
Look out!
*cough*
J, you have been terribly hurt! We must stop the bleeding!
*cough* Just half to death, still breathing. I'm not going down like this, French Fry.
Nah, gotta check on ... Hollick.
No ... *cough* Boss, stay back!
We didn't have to keep playing this little game, but you just won't be satisfied until it's over, will you?
Assemble, assemble!

In the aftermath of the story, some memories persist.
Tap here to go to [Alleyway Graffiti].
Two old friends are standing by the wall, reminiscing about the old days at the restaurant as they talk and eat. You might as well eavesdrop for your own amusement.
*Munching noises* I could live off of burritos forever! I love this city, San Francisco.
You hardly ever come back to San Francisco, and when you do, your first priority is to get your hands on a burrito?
Didn't you mention that J's shop had changed owners? What was their name again? Lyle? Leslie?
Legers. Haight Street has seen some rapid changes lately.
Who cares? As long as the taste hasn't changed, that's all that matters. *Chewing sounds* Remember the wall in the back alley? Is it still there?
Yes, it's still standing, but our graffiti from back then is probably covered up by now. The younger generation has probably left their own "masterpieces" on it.
*Swallowing sound* Let's go check it out. If the art sucks, I'll clean 'em right off.
So, what do you think? The artwork of the younger crowd on Haight Street.
Not bad at all, but the colors have faded! Hand me a spray can, and I'll spruce it up!
Tap here to see the graffiti wall.
Every can of spray paint is here, but how do we know what their original colors were?
Hmph. When it comes to graffiti, the colors are chosen based on the artist's mood.

Feeling angry? Grab a bright red. Feeling happy? Use vibrant yellow. Once you learn the backstory of the artist behind the graffiti, you can make accurate guesses about their chosen colors nine times out of ten.
So you want me to share their stories with you? You always know how to get others to do your work ...
I went around and collected all the details and gossip about these pieces. Are you really going to go through with this?
Don't worry, my hands aren't shaking from old age just yet. Watch closely.
Who in their right mind would spray their <nobr>self-portrait</nobr> on a wall? It's a miracle it hasn't been vandalized yet.
Come on, let's fix it and see how long it stays untouched.
For stories you're already familiar with, you can fix them directly.
Just tap here to remove the dust and bring the graffiti to its original glory.
Drag and swipe the spray paint to restore the faded graffiti to its original brilliance.
Mission accomplished! This is so much more fun than community service. I'd rather spend an afternoon <nobr>spray-painting</nobr> these walls than an hour tearing down ads.
Who knows, maybe a few years from now there will be new works of art adorning this very wall. I hope you'll still be around to see them.
And I hope you'll still have all your teeth by then, so we can enjoy biting into those spicy jalapeño rings together.

Aid Effects

1. When a deployed character (Combatant) gains their Ultimate in battle, they gain their Aider's Ultimate as well. |2. When casting an Aid incantation, the Afflatus and damage type of that incantation will match the corresponding deployed character (Combatant).

In A Series of Dusks, Tuning is replaced with Catalyst Incantations.
You can consume Stimulus to cast Catalyst incantations. Note that Stimulus cannot be gained through normal battle actions.
After battle, your remaining Stimulus will be carried over to the next battle.
In A Series of Dusks, certain incantation effects (for some characters) will be different from regular battles.
Incantation Rewrite

Rewrite: Certain battlefield rules can rewrite incantations, giving them different effects.|Scalding: At the end of the round, characters lose 10% Current HP for each of their incantations with this effect.|Icebound: The incantation cannot be cast or moved.|Variable: At the end of the round, the incantation changes to a random incantation of a random rank.
Incantation Syntony & Resonance

1. Casting ≥3 incantations of the same type in a round triggers Incantation Syntony, which provides stat boosts for that round.
2. The more incantations of the same type are cast, the higher the level of Incantation Syntony, up to a maximum of Lv.7. |3. Casting ≥3 different types of incantations in a round triggers Incantation Resonance, which provides stat boosts for that round.
4. The more different types of incantations are cast, the higher the level of Incantation Resonance, up to a maximum of Lv.7.

Tempering Artefacts
